sa: स चेन्निवृत्तबन्धस्तु विशुद्धश्चापि कर्मभिः। प्राप्नोति सुकृताँल्लोकान् यत्र गत्वा न शोचति॥
en: By casting off their bonds (of Karma) and by purifying Karma, men attain those regions of bliss where misery is unknown.

sa: तमापतन्तं सम्प्रेक्ष्य शूलहस्तं जिघांसया। यवक्री: सहसोत्थाय प्राद्रवद् येन वै सरः॥
en: Seeing him coming with the uplifted spear with the intention of killing him, Yavakrit suddenly rose and ran towards a tank.

sa: इच्छाम्यहं त्वया दत्तां प्रीतिं परमदुर्लभाम्। तामब्रवीत् ततः स्कन्दः प्रीतिमिच्छसि कीदृशीम्॥
en: I desire that you should give me great happiness." "To her Skanda replied,” What sort of happiness you desire to get?

sa: स विद्धो बहुभिर्बाणैर्दीप्तास्यैः पन्नगैरिव। ममार राक्षसं रूपं भूयः कृत्वा बिभीषणम्॥
en: Thus struck by the two arrows which were like flaming-mouthed snakes, Muka, assuming his fearful Rakshasas form, gave up his life.

sa: स मामुवाच राजेन्द्र प्रीयमाणो द्विजोत्तमः। दृष्टस्त्वया महादेवो यथा नान्येन केनचित्॥
en: O king of kings, that best of the Brahmanas said to me pleased "none else can Mahadeva as you have seen.

sa: श्रोतुमिच्छामि चरितं भूरिद्रविणतेजसाम्। कथ्यमानं त्वया विप्र परं कौतूहलं हि मे॥
en: O Brahmana, I desire to hear the history of those greatly effulgent heroes narrated by you. I am in great curiosity.

sa: तथा शालांस्तमालांश्च पाटलान् बकुलानपि। माला इव समासक्ताः शैलानां शिखरेषु च॥
en: Then again there were rows of Sala, Tamalas Patalas and Bakulas encircling the summing of the mountains like so many garlands.

sa: तेन तस्याभवत् सख्यं राघवस्य महात्मनः। स हत्वा वालिनं राज्ये सुग्रीवमभिषिक्तवान्॥
en: Then a friendship was contracted between that high-souled descendant of Raghu and Sugriva. Killing Bali, he gave him (Sugriva) the kingdom.

sa: सिसृक्षुः शिशिराण्येव दक्षिणां भजते दिशम्। ततः सर्वाणि भूतानि कालोऽभ्यर्च्छति शैशिरः॥
en: When he takes the southern direction with a view to cause dew, then the cold weather comes upon all the creatures.

sa: भासयन् सर्वभूतानि सुश्रियाभिविराजते। नात्र ब्रह्मर्षयस्तात कुत एव महर्षयः॥ प्राप्नुवन्ति गतिं ह्येतां यतीनां भावितात्मनाम्। न तं ज्योतींषि सर्वाणि प्राप्य भासन्ति पाण्डव॥
en: Displaying all creatures, appears grand with excellent gracefulness. Even the Brahmarshis cannot have and admittance there; how can the Maharshis? O excellent of the Kurus, only Yatis can have access to it. Nor, O Pandava, can all the luminaries shine (by him).

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एतच्छ्रुत्वा तु वचनंधनदेन प्रभाषितम्। पाण्डवाश्च ततस्तेन बभूवुः सम्प्रहर्षिताः॥
en: Vaishampayana said : The Pandavas, having listened to these words spoken by the giver of wealth, were much pleased with them.

sa: ऋत्विजं मन्यसे कृष्णमथ या कुरुनन्दन। द्वैपायने स्थिते वृद्धे कथं कृष्णोऽर्चितस्त्वया॥
en: O descendant of Kuru, if you consider Krishna as the Ritvija, when old Dvaipayana is here, how have you worshipped Krishna?

sa: एते कनखला राजन्तृषीणां दयिता नगाः। एषा प्रकाशते गङ्गा युधिष्ठिर महानदी।॥
en: O king, yonder is the Kanakhala mountain, the favourite resort of the Rishis, O Yudhishthira, yonder is the great river Ganga.

sa: तथा भीमो महेष्वासः संयुगे बलिनां वरः। गन्धर्वाञ्छतशो राजञ्जघान निशितैः शरैः॥
en: That great bowman, Bhima, that foremost of all strong men, killed in that battle thousands of Gandharvas with his sharp arrows.

sa: एतद् द्वारं महाराज मानसस्य प्रकाशते। वर्षमस्य गिरेमध्ये रामेण श्रीमता कृतम्॥
en: O great king, yonder appears the gate of Manaka. A gap was opened by Rama in the midst of this mountain.

sa: शरभोन्नादसंघुष्टं नानामृगनिषेवितम्। ते गन्धमादनवनं तन्नन्दनवनोपमम्॥ मुदिताः पाण्डुतनया मनोहृदयनन्दनम्। विविशुः क्रमशो वीराः शरण्यं शुभकाननम्॥ द्रौपदीसहिता वीरास्तैश्च विप्रैर्महात्मभिः। शृण्वन्तः प्रीतिजननान् वल्गून् मदकलाञ्छुभान्॥
en: Resounding with the roar of Saravas and inhabited by various other animals. Then with great delight, the heroic Pandavas gradually entered the forest of the Gandhamadana resembling the Nandana gardens, pleasant to the mind and heart, auspicious and capable of affording protection,

sa: तस्य पार्श्व विनिर्भिद्य ब्राह्मणस्य महासुरः। वातापिः प्रहसन् राजन् निश्चक्राम विशाम्पते॥
en: That great Asura Vatapi, O king, O ruler of earth, would laughingly come out ripping open the sides of these Brahmanas.

sa: युयुत्सुं संजयं चैव तथैवान्यान् सभासदः। सर्वानामन्त्र्य गच्छामि द्रष्टास्मि पुनरेत्य वः॥
en: To Yuyutsu, Sanjaya, and all the Sabhasadas (court-officials). I bed you all farewell. I shall see you (again) on my return.

sa: दृष्टो हि मम संक्लेशः पुरा पाण्डवनन्दन। न तवात्रापराधोऽस्ति कथंचिदपि पाण्डव॥
en: O son of Pandava, my disgrace was foreordained. O Pandava, no blame, therefore, in any way, can be attributed to you,

sa: आसीद्वा किं प्रभावश्च स दैत्यो मानवान्तकः। किमर्थं चोदितो मन्युरगस्त्यस्य महात्मनः॥
en: And what was the prowess of that meneating Daitya and why the anger of that highsouled (Rishi) was excited against him.

sa: नकुलं सहदेवं च दृष्ट्वा ते दुःखितावुभौ॥ अदुःखार्ही मनुष्येन्द्र कस्मान्मन्युर्न वर्धते।
en: Beholding, O king of men, these Nakula and Sahadeva, unworthy of misery, stricken with grief does not your anger blaze up?

sa: एतत् स्वयम्भुवो राजन् वनं दिव्यं प्रकाशते। यत्रायजत राजेन्द्र विश्वकर्मा प्रतापवान्॥
en: O king, this is the celestials forest of the self-create (Brahma) where, O king of kings, the powerful Vishvamitra-performed his sacrifices.

sa: श्रेयो यदत्रधर्मज्ञ ब्रूहि मे तदसंशयम्। करिष्यामि हि तत् सर्वं यथावदनुशासनम्॥
en: Tell me, without any doubt, O you conversant with duties, whatever leads to wellbeing. I shall obey duly all your commands.

sa: गङ्गा यत्र नदी पुण्या यस्यास्तीरे भगीरथः। अयजत् तत्र बहुभिः क्रतुभिर्भूरिदक्षिणैः॥
en: Here there is the river, the sacred Ganges; on the banks of Bhagirathi were performed many sacrifices with large Dakshinas (gift).

sa: ततः स चक्रे भगवानृषीणां विधिवत् तदा। सर्वेषां पुनराधानं विधिदृष्टेन कर्मणा॥ आज्यभागेन तत्राग्नि तर्पयित्वा यथाविधि। देवाः स्वभवनं याता ऋषयश्च यथाक्रमम्॥ तदरण्यं प्रविष्टस्य तुङ्गकं राजसत्तम्। पापं प्रणश्यत्यखिलं स्त्रियो वा पुरुषस्य वा॥
en: Gratifying Agni with libations of ghee poured according to the ordinance, the highsouled Bhrigu once more performed the Agnidhyana sacrifice for all those Rishis. After which both they and the celestials went away to their respective homes one after another. O foremost of kings, he who enters the forest of Tungaka, whether male or female, is cleansed of all his sins.

sa: इयं च नलिनी रम्या जाता पर्वतानिर्झरे। नेयं भवनमासाद्य कुबेरस्य महात्मनः॥
en: The lotus-lake has sprung up on the mountain breast. It has not been made in the abode of the illustrious Kubera.

sa: उवास च स्वयं तत्रधर्मराजः सनातनः। सर्वासां सरितां चैव समुद्भेदो विशाम्पते॥
en: And where dwelt the eternal king of justice (Yama) himself. O king, all the rivers have taken their rise from it.

sa: परिष्वक्तस्य तस्याशु भ्रात्रा भीमस्य भारत। श्रमो नाशमुपागच्छत् सर्वं चासीत् प्रदक्षिणम्॥
en: O descendant of Bharata, having been thus embraced by his brother, Bhima's fatigue was gone and all his strength was restored.

sa: एकार्णवे तदा लोके नष्टे स्थावरजङ्गमे। प्रणष्टेषु च भूतेषु सर्वेषु भरतर्षभ॥
en: O best of the Bharata race, when the world became one great ocean and all mobile and immobile creatures were killed,

sa: लोमशस्योपसंगृह्य पादौ द्वैपायनस्य च। नारदस्य च राजेन्द्र देवर्षेः पर्वतस्य च॥
en: O king of kings, then touching the feet of Lomasha, of Dvaipayana (Vyasa) of Narada and of the celestials Rishi Parvata.

sa: तवेमामापदं दृष्ट्वा समृद्धिं च सुयोधने। धातारं गर्हये पार्थ विषमं योऽनुपश्यति॥
en: O son of Pritha, seeing your misfortune and the prosperity of Suyodhana, I blame the Providence who sees such an inequality.

sa: तं न्यस्य वेद्यां कलशं सुषुपुस्ते महर्षयः। रात्रिजागरणाच्छ्रान्तान् सौद्युम्नि: समतीत्य तान्॥
en: Having been much fatigued by keeping up nights, those great Rishis placed that jar on the altar and went to sleep.

sa: चरुद्वयमिदं भद्रे जनन्याश्च तवैव च। विश्वमावर्तयित्वा तु मया यत्नेन साधितम्॥
en: O blessed girl, after having ransacked the whole universe these two Charus have been prepared by me with the utmost care.

sa: ते वा द्वादश वर्षाणि वयं वा द्यूतनिर्जिताः। प्रविशमे महारण्यमजिनैः प्रतिवासिताः॥
en: Attired in skins, either they or we, having (first) been defeated at dice, shall go into the forest for twelve years.

sa: उद्धृत्य गङ्गासलिलात् ततो मत्स्यं मनुः स्वयम्। समुद्रमनयत् पार्थ तत्र चैनमवासृजत्॥
en: O son of Pritha, Manu took it out of the Ganga and carried it to the sea and put it there.

sa: सान्त्वयित्वा तु तं पुत्रं निष्क्रम्सयान्त:पुरानृपः। ऋत्विजा सहितो राजन् सहामात्य उपाविशत्॥
en: Having comforted his son and come out from the female apartments, the king sat down with his family priest and ministers.

sa: चिन्तयामास च मनुस्तं पृथिवीपते। स च तच्चिन्तितं ज्ञात्वा मत्स्यः परपुरंजय॥
en: O ruler of earth, O conqueror of hostile cities, he thought of that fish and that fish also, knowing his thought,

sa: ततो दुःशासनो राजन् द्रौपद्या वसनं बलात्। सभामध्ये समाक्षिप्य व्यपाक्रष्टुं प्रचक्रमे॥
en: O king, thereupon Dushasana, in the sight of all (present) in the assembly, began to drag forcibly the cloth of Draupadi.

sa: मनुना च प्रजाः सर्वाः सदेवासुरमानुषाः। इष्टव्याः सर्वलोकाश्च यच्चेङ्गं यच्च नेङ्गति॥
en: Manu will create all beings, gods Asuras and men and all those who have power of locomotion and who have not.

sa: रेणुकायाश्च तत्रैव तीर्थं सिद्धनिषेवितम्। तत्र स्नात्वा भवेद् विप्रो निर्मलश्चन्द्रमा यथा॥
en: There is another Tirtha called Renuka, frequented by the Siddhas. Bathing in it, a Brahmana becomes as pure as the moon.

sa: एवमुक्त्वा ततः पार्थः सव्यसाची धनंजयः। ससर्जनिशितान् बाणान् खचरान् खचरान् प्रति॥
en: Having said this, the son of Pritha Savyasachi Dhananjaya (Arjuna) hurled a shower of sky-ranging and sharp arrows on those sky-rangers.

sa: तथैव स्यादानृशंस्यात् तथा स्याद् रूपसम्पदा। तथा स्याच्छीलसम्पत्त्या यामिच्छेत् पुरुषः स्त्रियम्॥३५
en: Who is such that for her softness of heart, wealth of beauty and virtue, one may desire her for a wife.

sa: संसत्सु समयं कृत्वा धर्मराड् भ्रातृभिः सह। पितॄस्तर्प्य यथान्यायं देवताश्च विशाम्पते॥
en: O king, Dharmaraja (Yudhishthira), having thus taken the vow with his brothers in that assembly, gratified the Pitris and the celestial.

sa: तदसां कृतं कर्म देवैरपि दुरासदम्। दृष्ट्वा मां पूजयामास मातलिः शक्रसारथिः॥
en: Seeing that I performed this unbearable feat (of arms), unachievable even by the celestials, Matali, the charioteer of Shakra, eulogised me;

sa: पूरयस्व महाबाहो समुद्रं लोकभावन। यत् त्वया सलिलं पीतं तदस्मिन् पुनरुत्सृज्॥
en: O mighty-armed one and O saviour of the world, fill up the Ocean (again). Give up the water drunk by you."

sa: मार्कण्डेय उवाच तच्छ्रुत्वाङ्गिरसो वाक्यं जातवेदास्तथाकरोत्। राजन् बृहस्पति भ तस्याप्यङ्गिरसः सुतः॥
en: Markandeya said : O king, having heard the words of Angiras, Agni did as desired; Angiras had a son, named Brihaspati.

sa: एवं सा तर्कयित्वा तु दमयन्ती विशाम्पत। दूतीं प्रस्थापयामास नैषधान्वेषणे शुभा॥
en: O lord of the earth, thus meditating, blessed Damayanti sent a female messenger in search of the king of the Nishadhas.

sa: एवमुक्त्वा ततः कृष्णामुवाह स घटोत्कचः। पाण्डूनां मध्यगो वीरः पाण्डवानपि चापरे॥
en: Vaishampayana said: Having said this, Ghatotkacha carried Krishna (Draupadi) in the midst of the Pandavas. The other (Rakshasas) carried the Pandavas.

sa: तव च भ्रातरं वीरमपश्यं सव्यसाचिनम्। शक्रस्यार्धासनगतं तत्र मे विस्मये महान्॥
en: saw your brother also, the heroic Savyasachi (Arjuna) sitting on the half of Shakra's seat and I became very much astonished,

sa: ततो निष्कण्टकं कृत्वा वनं तदपराजितः। द्रौपद्या सहधर्मज्ञो वसतिं तामुवास ह॥
en: Having made the forest free from its pest, the invincible and virtuous man (Yudhishthira) lived with Draupadi there in their abode.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच अथान्वशासन्नकुलं कुन्तीपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः। आरुह्येमां शमी वीर धनूंष्येतानि निक्षिप॥
en: Vaishampayana said: Then Yudhishthira, the son of Kunti, commanded Nakula-"O heroic one ascend this Shami tree and deposit those bows thereon.”

sa: अन्यो देवात् सहस्राक्षात् कृष्णाद् वा देवकीसुतात्। आचार्याश्च सपुत्राद् वा भारद्वाजान्महारथात्॥
en: Except the thousand-eyed Deity, Krishna, the son of Devaki, the preceptor his son, and the mighty car-warrior, the son of Bharadvaja.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच तथा कथयतोरेव तयोर्बुद्धिमतोस्तदा। शिवा नक्षत्रसम्पन्ना सा व्यतीयाय शर्वरी॥शा
en: Vaishampayana said The two wise men talking together in this way spent that night which was beautiful and lit by stars.

sa: मम धर्मार्थयुक्तं हि श्रुत्वा वाक्यमनामयम्। न चेदादास्यते बालो दिष्टस्य वशमेष्यति॥
en: If after listening to my beneficial advice, they do not accept it, the fool will feel the consequence of his luck.

sa: विद्राव्य शतशो गुल्मान् धार्तराष्ट्रस्य सैनिकान्। पर्यक्रामत् समन्ताच्च पार्थेन सह केशवः॥
en: Routing hundreds of groups of soldiers of the son of Dhritarashtra Keshava wandered about in company with the son of Pritha.

sa: संजय उवाच मुख्यमन्धकवृष्णीनामपश्यं कृष्णमागतम्। चेकितान् च तत्रैव युयुधानं च सात्यकिम्॥
en: Sanjaya said The chief of the Andhakas and Vrishnis, Krishna have I seen come there; as also Chekitana, Yuyudhana and Satyaki.

sa: श्वेतोष्णीषाश्च दृश्यन्ते त्रय एते जनार्दन धार्तराष्ट्रषु सैन्येषु तान् विजानीहि केशव॥
en: These there were seen also with white head gears the army of the son of Dhritarashtra; know their, names, O Keshava.

sa: विसृज्य सर्वान् नृपतीन् विराटप्रमुखांस्तदा। पाण्डवा भ्रातरः पञ्च भानावस्तं गते सति॥
en: Then after sending all the rulers of men headed by king Virata, the five Pandavas brothers, when the sun had set,

sa: हताश्वं विरथं पार्थं पौरुषे पर्यवस्थितम्। निःश्वसन्तं यथा नागमद्य पश्यन्तु कौरवाः॥
en: The Kauravas will see today Partha with his car broken, steeds killed, the bravery gone and himself sighing like a serpent.

sa: न हि पुत्रं न नप्तारं न भ्रातरमरिंदमाः। समतिक्रान्तमर्यादं पूजयन्ति नराधिपाः॥
en: Because the kings show no consideration even to their sons, grandsons and brothers when they are found to disregarded their dignity.

sa: श्रुतं भवद्भिर्यद् वृत्तं सभायां कुरुसंसदि। केशवस्यापि यद् वाक्यं तत् सर्वमवधारितम्॥
en: You have heard what happened in that assemblage of the Kurus and you have also understood what words Keshava has said.

sa: तस्य शङ्खस्य शब्देन रथनेमिस्वनेन च। गाण्डीवस्य च घोषेण पृथिवी समकम्पत॥
en: The earth shook with the sound of his conch, the rattle of his chariot and the twang of his Gandiva bow,

sa: सनातनौ महात्मानौ कृष्णावेकरथे स्थितौ। दुर्योधन तदा तात स्मर्ताऽसि वचनं मम॥
en: The two eternal and noble-souled Krishna's seated on the same chariot, O Duryodhana, O dear, then will you remember my words.

sa: स्पर्धया च बलोन्मत्तौ तावुभौ सूतपाण्डवौ। निशीथे पर्यकर्षेतां बलिनौ निर्जने स्थले॥
en: Then both Suta and Pandava, maddened with their strength, challenged and grappled with each other at night in that secluded hall.

sa: कुरून् परिभवेत् सर्वान् पञ्चालानपि भारत। पाण्डवेयांश्च सम्प्राप्तो मम क्लेशो ह्यरिंदम॥
en: () repressor of foes, this my misery surely brings humiliation, O Bharata, on all the Kurus, the Panchalas and the Pandavas.

sa: अभिद्रुत्य सुशर्माणं केशपक्षे परामृशत्। समुद्यम्य तु रोषात् तं निष्पिपेष महीतले॥
en: Rushing upon Susharma he held him by the hair; and lifting him up in anger he dashed him against the earth.

sa: ब्रवीतु वदतां श्रेष्ठो निशा समभिवर्तते। ततः सेनापतिं कृत्वा कृष्णस्य वशवर्तिनः॥
en: Let the foremost of speakers speak, for it is now almost night; having selected our general, under the guidance of Krishna,

sa: अगस्त्यशास्तां च दिशं प्रयाताः स्म जनार्दन। अचिरेणैव कालेन प्राप्स्यामो यमसादनम्॥
en: Were going towards the direction ruled by Agastya, O Janardana, and in a short time we reached the abode of Yama.

sa: हुताशनेन यच्चापः प्रविश्यच्छन्नमासता। विबुधानां कृतं कर्म तच्च सर्वं श्रुतं त्वया॥
en: And also Hutashana entering into water and remaining in disguise, obtained the purpose of the gods, have been heard by you?

sa: ध्यानयोगाद् बलं लब्ध्वा प्राप्य बुद्धिमनुत्तमाम्। जगाम शाश्वती सिद्धिं परां निर्वाणलक्षणाम्॥
en: Having acquired power by means of knowledge. He acquired excellent understanding and obtained that supreme state of emancipation which is eternal.

sa: उपान्वारोहतु रथं कुन्तीपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः। छत्रं च ते महाश्वेतं भीमसेनो महाबलः॥
en: Yudhishthira, the son of Kunti, drive in the chariot behind you. Let also the son of Kunti, Bhimasena of great strength,

sa: एवमेव महात्मानः प्रच्छन्नास्तत्र तत्र ह। अजयञ्छात्रवान् युद्धे तथा त्वमपि जेष्यसि॥
en: Having disguised in many places, high souled persons have conquered their foes in battle, thus you will also win your enemies.

sa: अमानुषं कृतं कर्म तं दृष्ट्वा विनिपातितम्। क्वास्य ग्रीवा क्व चरणौ क्व पाणी क्व शिरस्तथा इति स्म तं परीक्षन्ते गन्धर्वेण हतं तदा॥
en: When they saw him they were struck with wonder. Seeing that super-human work of his destruction. (They said) : “Where is his neck, where are his feet, arms and where is his head.” They then concluded that he had been slain by the Gandharvas.

sa: उत्सृज्य विनिवर्तन्ते ज्ञातयः सुहृदः सुताः। अपुष्पानफलान् वृक्षान् यथा तात पतत्रिणः॥
en: After leaving behind the body, do the cousins, friends and sons return as birds do trees devoid of blossoms and fruits.

sa: फलाहारोऽस्मि निष्क्रान्तस्त्वया सह सुमध्यमे। ततः पाटयत: काष्ठं शिरसो मे रुजाभवत्॥
en: "O slender-waisted damsel, I set out with you for gathering fruits. And when I was hewing down the woods my headached.

sa: यथाहं धृतराष्ट्रेण शिष्टः पूर्वमितो गतः। अब्रुवं पाण्डवान् गत्वा तन्निबोधत पार्थिवाः॥
en: What I, instructed by Dhritarashtra before having gone there from hence said to the sons Pandu, listen to that, O rulers.

sa: समृद्धिरसमृद्धिर्वा पूर्वेषां मम संजय। एवं विद्वान् युद्धमना भव मा प्रत्युपाहर॥
en: “Whether there be increase or decrease I will fight,"O Sanjaya, engage in fight with this thought and do not turn back.

sa: यः संश्रयः पाण्डवानां देवानामिव वासवः। तेन वो वासुदेवेन पाण्डवा अभ्ययुञ्जत॥
en: He who is the refuge of the Pandavas as Vasava is of the gods, with that Vamdeva will the Pandavas fight.

sa: वने महति तस्मिंस्तु रामः सौमित्रिणा सह। ददर्श मृगयूथानि द्रवमाणानि सर्वशः॥
en: In that great forest Rama together with the son of Sumitra (Lakshmana) saw many herds of deer flying in all directions.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच दृष्ट्वा व्यूढान्यनीकानि कुरूणां कुरुनन्दन। तत्र वैराटिमामन्त्र्य पार्थो वचनमब्रवीत्॥
en: Vaishampayana said Seeing the Kuru army arranged in order of battle, the son of Pandu, Partha, addressing Virata's son said :

sa: इज्याध्ययनदानानि तपः सत्यं क्षमा घृणा। अलोभ इति मार्गोऽयं धर्मस्याष्टविधः स्मृतः॥
en: Sacrificial ceremonies, study, gift, devotion, truth, forgiveness, mercy and contentment, these are the eight ways to virtue, according to the Smriti.

sa: ततो घोरतमः शब्दो रणे समभवत् तदा। भीमार्जुनयमान् दृष्ट्वा सैन्यानां सयुधिष्ठिरान्॥
en: Then there arose a dreadful noise in the encounter when the soldiers saw, Bhima, Arjuna and the twin brothers with Yudhishthira.

sa: दैवतं विष्णुरेतेषां विष्णुरेव परायणम्। हृदि चैषां सदा विष्णुर्विष्णुरेव सदा गतिः॥
en: Vishnu is their god; and their object of worship, Vishnu, is ever in their heart; and Vishnu is ever their refuge.

sa: विदुर उवाच अप्राप्तकाल वचनं बृहस्पतिरपि ब्रुवन्। लभते बुद्ध्यवज्ञानमवमानं च भारत॥
en: Vidura said Even Brihaspati by speaking when suitable time has not come gets a charge of ignorance and insult, O Bharata.

sa: यथाहमिह वक्तव्यं सर्वथा धर्मलिप्सया। तत्र नाहं तथा मन्ये यतायमितरो जनः॥
en: And calm, while speaking in the midst of an assembly, should always speak the truth if he wishes to acquire virtue.

sa: तमुवाचाथ सावित्री श्वः फलानि हरिष्यसि। योगक्षेमार्थमेतं ते नेष्यामि परशुं त्वहम्॥
en: And Savitri said to him “gather fruit tomorrow. I shall carry your hatchet which is conducive to your devotion and welfare."

sa: समुत्सृजन्ती मञ्जूषामश्वनद्यां तदा जले। उवाच रुदती कुन्ती यौनि वाक्यानि तच्छृणु॥
en: And hear the words which Kunti uttered while she, weeping bitterly, consigned the basket to the waters of the river Ashva.

sa: हतेषु तेषु रक्षःसु ततः शूर्पणखा पुनः। ययौ निकृत्तनासोष्ठी लङ्का भ्रातुर्निवेशनम्॥
en: Those Rakshasas being slain, Shurpanakha with her nose and lips cut off returned to Lanka, the abode of her brother (Ravana).

sa: तौ यात्वा पुरुषव्याघ्रौ द्वारकां कुरुनन्दनौ। सुप्तं ददृशतुः कृष्णं शयानं चाभिजग्मतुः॥
en: The two sons of Kuru, foremost among men, having reached Dwraka, saw Krishna asleep and went near him as he lay.

sa: शते द्वे तु ममाश्वानामीदृशानां द्विजोत्तम। इतरेषां सहस्राणि सुबहूनि चरन्ति मे॥
en: But two hundred only of horses of this breed I have; of other sorts thousands are roving about in my territories.

sa: रामस्य माता कौसल्य कैकेयी भरतस्य तु। सुतौ लक्ष्मणशत्रुघ्नौ सुमित्रायाः परंतपौ॥
en: Rama's mother was Kausalaya, Bharata's mother was Kaikeyi and Sumitra was the mother of Lakshmana and Shatrughana, the repressors of enemies.

sa: यथा विष्णुकुले लक्ष्मीर्यथा स्वाहा विभावसोः। कुले तव तथैवास्तु गुणकेशी सुमध्यमा॥
en: As Lakshmi in the family of Vishnu, Svaha in that of Agni, may the slender-waist Gunakeshi be same to your family.

sa: यत् सभायां स पाञ्चालीं क्लिश्यमानां दुरात्मभिः। दृष्टवानसि तस्याद्य फलमाप्नुहि केवलम्॥
en: Do you reap now the fruit of your suffering the Panchala princess to-be distressed by the wicked-souled one in the court.

sa: किं नु मां मन्यसे पार्थ सुखिनीति परंतप। एवं दुःखशताविष्टा युधिष्ठिरनिमित्ततः॥
en: O Pritha's son, afflicted with hundreds of sorrows on account of Yudhishthira, do you deem me happy, O repressor of foes.

sa: ततस्तु द्रौपदी गत्वा तदा भीमं महानसे। उपातिष्ठत कल्याणी कौरव्यं पतिमन्तिकम्॥
en: Thinking of the meeting could not perceive that the day had passed away. Thereupon going to Bhima in the kitchen Draupadi.

sa: पार्थः पञ्च शतान् शूरान् पर्वतीयान् महारथान्। परीप्समानः सौवीरं जघान ध्वजिनीमुखे॥
en: Wishing to seize the Sauvira king, Partha too killed five hundred brave mountaineers fighting in the van of the Sindhu army.

sa: अष्टौ पूर्वनिमित्तानि नरस्य विनशिष्यतः। ब्राह्मणान् प्रथमं द्वेष्टि ब्राह्मणैश्च विरुध्यते॥ ब्राह्मणस्वानि चादत्ते ब्राह्मणांश्च जिघांसति। रमते निन्दया चैषां प्रशंसां नाभिनन्दति॥ नैनान् स्मरति कृत्येषु याचितश्चाभ्यसूयति। एतान् दोषान् नरः प्राज्ञो बुध्येद् बुद्ध्वा विसर्जयेत्।।
en: Eight preliminary causes ruin a man; despising the Brahmanas, the struggle with the Brahmanas, the acquirement of a Brahmana's wealth taking the life of Brahmana, rejoicing at reviling them, disapproval of praise to them, not remembering them on occasions of festivity and finding fault with them when they ask for anything. These defects should a wise man understanding them, should avoid.

sa: एनं नित्यमुपासन्त कुरवः किंकरा यथा। सर्वे च राजन् राजानो धनेश्वरमिवामराः॥
en: O king! As the gods pray Kubera, the treasurer, all kings and Kauravas used to follow his orders daily like servants.

sa: ततो राज्ञा सहासीनाः सर्वे ते वनवासिनः। जातकौतूहलाः पार्थं पप्रच्छुर्नृपतेः सुतम्॥
en: Then O Partha all those inhabitants of forest, who were seated with the king, actuated by curiosity asked the kings son.

sa: अफलं मन्यसे वाऽपि पुरुषस्य पराक्रमम्। न चान्तरेण कर्माणि पौरुषेण फलोदयः॥
en: You consider, too, that human strength (alone) is without avail and that human desires are fruitless save when attended with action.

sa: ममत्ववेक्षया वीर शृणु विज्ञापयामि ते। भवानिह च सारथ्ये वासुदेवसमो युधि॥
en: O hero, listen to what I tell you, you are a great king equal to the son of Vasudeva in battle.

sa: सोऽयं वत्से महाभार आहितस्त्वयि साम्प्रतम्। त्वं सदा नियता कुर्या ब्राह्मणस्याभिराधनम्॥
en: O child, now this highly fortunate one is entrusted to your care. You should be particularly careful in ministering to him.

sa: तं दृष्ट्वा तस्य दुर्बुद्धेरविन्ध्यः पापनिश्चयम्। शमयामास संक्रुद्धं श्रूयतां येन हेतुना॥
en: Now hear how Avindhya, seeing the evilminded one bent on this reprehensible act, softened down his wrath by showing these reasons.

sa: प्रतिजज्ञे च काकुत्स्थः समरे वालिनो वधम्। सुग्रीवश्चापि वैदेह्याः पुनरानयनं नृप॥
en: (And) the descendant of Kakustha promised to kill Bali in battle; and O king, Sugriva also pledged himself to liberate Sita.

sa: कश्चिदुत्तरमेतेषां वक्तुं नोत्सहते पुमान्। इति सर्वे मनोभिस्ते चिन्तयन्ति स्म पार्थिवाः॥
en: No man ventured to say anything in reply and all the rulers of the earth began to think in own minds.

sa: ब्रह्मर्षीश्चापि देवांश्च गोपायस्व त्रिविष्टपे। अभिषिक्तः स राजेन्द्र ततो राजा त्रिविष्टपे॥
en: Protect also the Brahmarshis and the gods in heaven. And that chief among the kings being anointed the king in heaven.

sa: एको धर्मः परं श्रेयः क्षमैका शान्तिरुत्तमा विद्यैका परमा तृप्तिरहिंसैका सुखावहा॥
en: Virtue is the only highest good forgiveness the supreme peace, knowledge the deepest satisfaction and benevolence the one cause of happiness.

sa: तृणानि भूमिरुदकं वाक् चतुर्थी च सूनृता। सतामेतानि गेहेषु नोच्छिद्यन्ते कदाचन॥
en: A straw seat, room to sit in, water and sweet words, these are never wanting in the house of the good.

sa: अथ सर्वे रणं मुक्त्वा प्रयाताः खेचरा दिवम्। अस्मानेवाभिकर्षन्तो दीनान् मुदितमानसाः॥
en: Thereupon those rangers of skies, abandoning the fight fled through the sky and dragged our poor-selves after them in great joy.

sa: ततो दुर्योधनमिदं धृतराष्ट्रोऽब्रवीद् वचः। मैवं वोचः प्रजापाल नैष धर्मः सनातनः॥
en: Dhritarashtra then said these words to Duryodhana, do not say so, O you protector of men. This is against eternal virtue.

sa: अश्वबन्धोऽथ नकुलः सहदेवस्तु गोकुले। सैरन्ध्रीं द्रौपदीं विद्धि यत्कृते कीचका हताः॥
en: Nakula is in charge of steeds and Sahadeva is in cow-pen and know Sairandhri as Draupadi for whom Kichaka's were slain.

sa: ततो दुर्योधनस्याङ्के वर्तन्तामकुतोभयाः। अधार्मिकी तु मा बुद्धि मौात् कुर्वन्तु केवलात्।।१४।
en: Then may they come to seek refuse with Duryodhana without any fear; let them not through folly adopt an unrighteous course,

sa: तथा सम्बन्धकं तुल्यमस्माकं त्वयि माधव। अहं चाभिगतः पूर्वं त्वामद्य मधुसूदन॥
en: And, O slayer of Madhu our relations with you are the same and this day I have come first to you.

sa: पितामहं च द्रोणं च कृपं कर्णं च दुर्जयम्। जयद्रथं सोमदत्तमश्वत्थामानमेव च।॥ सुतेजसो महेष्वासानिन्द्रोऽपि सहितोऽमरैः। अशक्तः समरे जेतुं किं पुनस्तात पाण्डवाः॥
en: Our grandfather Bhishma, Drona, Kripa and Karna hard to be vanquished, Jayadratha, Somadatta and Ashvathama, Indra even, united with the gods, is incapable of defeating these great bowmen endued with great energy in battle. How can the Pandavas do it, O sire.

sa: तत्र देवर्षिसदृशीं पूजां स प्राप नारदः। महेन्द्रसदृशीं चैव मातलिः प्रत्यपद्यत॥
en: There that Narada received greetings suitable for a divine Rishi and Matali received what is generally offered to the great Indra.

sa: यान्तु सहितास्तत्र विराटनगरं प्रति। क्षिप्रं गोपान् समासाद्य गृह्णन्तु विपुलं धनम्॥
en: Let them with (Trigarta) go to the city of Virata and securing speedily his kine, let them take his immense wealth.

sa: राम उवाच इत्युक्त्वा शरवर्षेण सर्वतः समवाकिरत्॥ दम्भोद्भवस्तापसं तं जिघांसुः सहसैनिकः।
en: Rama said Saying these Dambhodbhava with his army, desirous of killing that devotee, covered all sides with a downpour of arrows.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच तामामन्त्र्य च गोविन्दः कृत्वा चाभिप्रदक्षिणम्। प्रातिष्ठत महाबाहुर्दुर्योधनगृहान् प्रति॥
en: Vaishampayana said Govinda of long arms bidding adieu to her and also going round her, went towards the residence if Duryodhana.

sa: इत्युक्त्वा केशवं तत्र तथा चोक्त्वा विनिश्चयम्। अनुज्ञातो निववृते परिष्वज्य जनार्दनम्॥
en: Having thus addressed Keshava and thus given out his resolve, he (Arjuna) returned at his bidding after first going round Janardana.

sa: यदृच्छयाथ तद् रक्षः करे जग्राह लक्ष्मणम्। विषादमगमत् सद्यः सौमित्रिरथ भारत॥
en: And that Rakshasa with great ease seized Lakshmana by the hand. (Thus overpowered), O Bharata, Lakshmana was instantaneously seized with dismay.

sa: महानयं कृष्णं कृतः क्षत्रस्य समुदानयः। राज्यं प्राप्तमिदं दीप्तं प्रथितं सर्वराजसु॥
en: O Krishna, this assembly of Kshatriyas is great indeed; this blazing kingdom known among all kings is already won (by Yudhishthira).

sa: स पूज्यमानः कुरुभिः संशृण्वन् मधुराः कथाः। यथार्ह प्रातसत्कुर्वन् प्रेक्षमाणः शनैर्ययौ॥
en: He proceeded slowly along gazing in all directions, worshipped by the Kurus; and listening to sweet speeches and returning suitable greetings.

sa: न तथेच्छन्ति कल्याणान् परेषां वेदितुं गुणान्। यथैषां ज्ञातुमिच्छन्ति नैर्गुण्यं पापचेतसः॥
en: Evil-minded persons do not seek to know the good qualities of men; so much so they desire to know their defects.

sa: स बिभ्रत् कवचं चाइयं स्वयमप्यंशुमत्प्रभम्। ध्वजं च सिंहमुच्छ्रिस्य सारथ्ये समकल्पयत्॥
en: Himself putting on an armour effulgent like the sun and hoisting the lion flag he appointed him (Brihannala, as his charioteer).

sa: इत्युक्त्वा केशवं तत्र राजमध्ये युधिष्ठिरः। अनुज्ञातो निववृते कृष्णां कृत्वा प्रदक्षिणम्॥
en: Yudhishthira, having thus addressed Keshava in the midst of those kings, returned at the bidding of Krishna, after going round him.

sa: मानेन रक्ष्यते धान्यमश्वान् रक्षत्यनुक्रमः। अभीक्ष्णदर्शनं गाश्च स्त्रियो रक्ष्याः कुचैलतः।। :॥
en: Corn is preserves by measure exercise preserves steeds; strict and constant supervision preserves horses; and women is preserved by ragged garments.

sa: एतत् सर्वं मयाऽऽख्यातं कारणं विस्तरेण वः। यथावृत्तं सुखोदर्कमिदं दुःखं महन्मम॥
en: I have now faithfully described to you in detail the cause which ultimately turned my great sorrow into a crowing bliss.

sa: जानात्येष हृषीकेशं पुराणं यच्च वै परम्। शुश्रूषमाणमेकाग्रयं मोक्ष्यते महतो भयात्॥
en: This man knows the ancient and blessed Being Hrishikesha. Listening to him with earnestness, you free from even the greatest dangers.

sa: सम्भोजनं संकथनं सम्प्रीतिश्च परस्परम्। ज्ञातिभिः सह कार्याणि न विरोधः कदाचन॥
en: To eat together, to talk together and to love one another-these are what should be done among cousins and quarrels never.

sa: शूरा धृतराष्ट्रस्य भीष्मस्य विदुरस्य च। तिष्ठेयुः पाण्डवाः सर्वे हित्वा मानमधश्चराः॥
en: I said-"Those heroes, the sons of Pandu, will remain dependent on Dhritarashtra, Bhishma and Vidura as their subordinates, abandoning their pride.

sa: मालिनी जनयामास पुत्रमेकं विभीषणम्। राकायां मिथुनं जज्ञे खरः शूर्पणखा तथा॥
en: On Malini he begot one son named Vibhishana; on Raka he begot one son and one daughter named Khara and Shurpanakha.

sa: समाहितो हि बीभत्सुर्वर्षाण्यष्टौ च पञ्च च। जातस्नेहश्च युद्धेऽस्मिन् मयि सम्प्रहरिष्यति॥
en: Bibhatsu was engaged in religious meditation for the last thirteen years and so he will strike me mildly in the conflict.

sa: कङ्कालं मुसलं घोरं कापालमथ किङ्किणीम्॥ वधार्थं रक्षसा यानि ददाम्येतानि सर्वशः।
en: And I will confer upon you Kankala, and the dreadful Musala, and Kapāla, and Kinkiņi-all those that intended for slaughtering Rākşasas.

sa: स समर्थो महाप्राज्ञस्तव युद्धविशारदः। द्वन्द्वयुद्धं स दातुं ते नमुचेरिव वासवः॥
en: That mighty wise one, skilled in warfare, is capable of fighting with you on equal terms like to Namuci with Vasava.

sa: यथा विजृम्भते सिंहो विवृते गिरिगह्वरे। मारुतस्यौरसः : पुत्रस्तथा सम्प्रति जृम्भते॥
en: As a lion fills himself with vigour in an open we, so the son of the Wind-god filled himself with energy.

sa: कामं वा स्वयमेवाद्य तत्र मां नेतुमर्हसि। यत्रासौ पुरुषव्याघ्रस्तप्यते मे सुतस्तपः॥
en: Or it behoves you to yourself bring me to the place where that foremost of men, my son, is performing austerities.

sa: मिथिलोपवने तत्र आश्रमं दृश्य राघवः। पुराणं निर्जनं रम्यं पप्रच्छ मुनिपुङ्गवम्॥
en: And in a grove at Mithilā, Rāghava saw an ancient, lonely, and romantic asylum, and asked that foremost of ascetics, saying.

sa: अवश्यं विनशिष्यन्ति सर्वे रावण राक्षसाः। रेगां त्वं कर्क राजा दुर्बुद्धिरजितेन्द्रियः॥
en: All the Rākşasas shall surely die, O Rāvana whose lord are you, foolish, cruel and under the control of your passions.

sa: तच्छूलं वज्रसंकाशं गगने ज्वलनोपमम्। द्वाभ्यां शराभ्यां चिच्छेद रामः शस्त्रभृतां वरः॥
en: That best of those bearing arms cut off with two arrows that dart resembling the thunder-bolt and flaming in the sky.

sa: कोटिं तत्र समुद्रस्य काञ्चनीं शतयोजनाम्॥ दुर्दशां पारियात्रस्य गत्वा द्रक्ष्यथ वानराः।
en: Proceeding further, the monkeys shall behold the golden summit of Pāriyātra rising from the sea and extending over an hundred Yojanas.

sa: तदनसम्भवं दिव्यं फलमूलं मनोहरम्। यः कश्चित् सकृदश्नाति मासं भवति तर्पितः॥
en: He that partakes of those excellent fruits and roots sprung from the sacrificial ingredients, does not experience hunger for a month.

sa: सर्वथा सदृशं सीते मम स्वस्य कुलस्य च। व्यवसायमनुक्रान्ता कान्ते त्वमतिशोभनम्॥
en: Your determination to follow me, O beautiful one, is very excellent and is in perfect keeping with myself and my family.

sa: किं वक्ष्यामो महाबाहुरनसूयः प्रियंवदः। नीतः स राघवोऽस्माभिरिति वक्तुं कथं क्षमम्॥
en: What shall we say (when people ask us?) How can we say, 'We took hence the mightyarmed, sweet-speeched and unavenging Rāma?

sa: एवमुक्त्वा महाबाहुः सबाष्पः कैकयीसुतः। रामस्य शिरसा पादौ जग्राह भरतः पुनः॥
en: Having said this, with tears flooding his eyes, the mighty-armed son of Kaikeyi, Bharata, again took Rāma's feet on this head.

sa: ब्राह्मणेभ्यश्च रत्नानि भिक्षुकेभ्यश्च भोजनम्। देहि चाशंसमानेभ्यः संत्वरस्व च मा चिरम्॥
en: Do you give away jewels to the Brāhmaṇas and edibles to the beggars longing for them, and make haste without delay.

sa: मम रूपं समास्थाय कृतवानसि दुर्मते। अकर्तव्यमिदं यस्माद् विफलस्त्वं भविष्यसि ॥
en: 'And since, O you of wicked understanding, assuming my form, you have done this foul. deed, you shall lose your scrotum.'

sa: भगीरथस्तु राजर्षिार्मिको रघुनन्दन। अनपत्यो महाराजः प्रजाकामः स च प्रजाः॥ मन्त्रिष्वाधाय तद् राज्यं गङ्गावतरणे रतः। तपो दीर्घ समातिष्ठद् गोकर्णे रघुनन्दन ॥
en: O descendant of Raghu, that royal saint Bhagiratha was possessed of righteousness. And being without issue, and desiring to obtain it, the mighty monarch consigned his kingdom and his subjects to the care of his counsellors, and engaged in bringing down Gangā.

sa: ते गतिज्ञा गतिं गत्वा पृथिव्यां सर्ववानराः। आनयन्तु हरीन् सर्वांस्त्वरिताः शासनान्मम॥
en: Let all the monkeys on earth, acquainted with motion lying themselves and summoning speed at my command, bring all the monkeys.

sa: सा नूनं नगरी दीना दृष्ट्वास्मान् राघवं विना। भविष्यति निरानन्दा सस्त्रीबालवयोऽधिका॥
en: Surely seeing us without Rāghava, the forlorn city with her women, children and grown up folks will be plunged in grief.

sa: गृहं प्रविष्टे सुग्रीवे विमुक्ते गगने घनैः। वर्षरात्रे स्थितो रामः कामशोकाभिपीडितः॥ पाण्डुरं गगनं दृष्ट्वा विमलं चन्द्रमण्डलम्। शारदी रजनी चैव दृष्ट्वा ज्योत्स्नानुलेपनाम्॥ कामवृत्तं च सुग्रीवं नष्टां च जनकात्मजाम्। दृष्ट्वा कालमतीतं च मुमोह परमातुरः॥
en: Sugrīva having entered his palace, and the sky being cleared of the clouds, Rāma, racked with grief, passing the rainy season and beholding the yellow welkin, the clear disc of the Moon, the autumnal right sprinkled with the rays of the Moon, the amour-stricken lord of monkeys, the ravishment of the daughter of Janaka, and the season well-nigh expired, became overwhelmed with sorrow and senseless.

sa: चरन्तो मृगधां हृष्टाः पापेनोपाधिना वने। अनेन निहता राम राजानः कामरूपिणा॥
en: This vicious Mārīca, O Rāma, assuming the shape of a deer oftentimes kills at pleasure the kings who come here a-hunting.

sa: पतत्त्रिणा तथा सार्धं सुस्थितेन च चेतसा। अवसद् रजनीमेकां कौसल्या धर्मकाम्यया।॥
en: And with the view of reaping merit, Kausalyā, with an undisturbed heart passed one night with that horse furnished with wings.

sa: एवं ब्रुवाणं काकुत्स्थं प्रतिवार्य शुचिस्मिता। उवाच सीता संहृष्टा छद्मना हृतचेतना॥
en: When Lakşınaņa spoke thus Sītā with a pure smile being under the influence of enchantment contradicted him, and being pleased said

sa: वसिष्ठस्य वचः श्रुत्वा भरतो धरणीं गतः। प्रेतकृत्यानि सर्वाणि कारयामास धर्मवित्॥
en: Hearing Vasistha's words, Bharata cognisant of duty, bowed down to the ground and despatched the ministers for performing the last rites.

sa: सहायेन च सुग्रीव त्वया रामः प्रतापवान्। वधिष्यति रणे शत्रूनचिरान्नात्र संशयः॥
en: O Sugrīva, by your help, the puissant Rāma shall speedily slay his foe. Of this there is not the least doubt.

sa: तृतीयसवनं चैव राज्ञोऽस्य सुमहात्मनः। चकुस्ते शास्त्रतो दृष्ट्वा यथा ब्राह्मणपुङ्गवाः ॥
en: Those foremost of Brahmanas, in due form, and according to the ordinance, officiated at the third bath of that high-souled monarch.

sa: राजा दशरथः श्रीमान् यथा मम महायशाः। पूजनीयश्च मान्यश्च तथायं पतगेश्वरः॥
en: Like to the highly famous, effulgent king Dasaratha, this King of birds is worthy of being adored and worshipped by me.

sa: प्रोत्साहितोऽयं कैकेय्या संतुष्टो यदि नः पिता। अमित्रभूतो निःसङ्गं वध्यतां वध्यतामपि॥
en: If father being propitiated and excited by Kaikeyi, turns out to be our enemy, he shall be slain, without any hesitation.

sa: बहूनि रक्षसां वासे वर्षाणि वसता सुखम्। अनेन दण्डकारण्ये विशीर्णमिह पक्षिणा॥
en: Living happily, for years, in this forest of Dandaka inhabited by the Rākşasas, Jațāyu has, at last, given up his life.

sa: कृतं हि प्रियमस्माकं राघवेण महात्मना। तस्य चेत्प्रतिकारोऽस्ति सफलं जीवितं भवेत्॥
en: The high-souled Rāghava had done us good. If we can serve him in turn, our life shall be crowned with success.

sa: धर्मादर्थः प्रभवति धर्मात् प्रभवते सुखम्। धमेण लभते सर्वं धर्मसारमिदं जगत्॥
en: Interest springs from righteousness; and happiness also results therefrom. One attains everything through righteousness, in this world the only substantial thing.

sa: एवमुक्ता ततस्तुष्टा जननी ते महाकपे। गुहायां त्वां महाबाहो प्रजज्ञे प्लवगर्षभ॥
en: Thus addressed, O mighty monkeys, your other, O long-armed one, O foremost of monkeys, your has to you in a cave.

sa: एवं ब्रुवन्तं राजानं वसिष्ठः पुनरेव हि। न्यमन्त्रयत धर्मात्मा पुनः पुनरुदारधीः॥
en: As the king was speaking thus, the righteous souled and generous Vasiştha again and again pressed him to accept his hospitality.

sa: स प्रविश्यैव धर्मात्मा स्वगृहं श्रीविवर्जितम्। भरतः प्रेक्ष्य जग्राह जनन्याश्चरणौ शुभौ॥
en: On entering his own quarter which he found deprived of grace, the virtuous Bharata took hold of his mother's auspicious feet.

sa: तया परुषमुक्तस्तु कुपितो राघवानुजः। स विकाङ्क्षन् भृशं रामं प्रतस्थे नचिरादिव॥
en: Having been addressed with those harsh words the younger brother of Rāghava, enraged, proceeded at once, being anxious to see Rāma.

sa: तच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं तस्य स्नेहपर्याकुलाक्षरम्। समन्युः कौशिकौ वाक्यं प्रत्युवाच महीपतिम् ॥
en: Hearing those words of Dasaratha's composed of letters faltering with affection, Kusika's son, stirred up with anger, answered the monarch, saying,

sa: नैतदौपयिकं राम यदिदं परितप्यसे। विषादयसि सीतां च मां चैव पुरुर्षभ॥
en: This is not fit that you should grieve; for thereby, O foremost of men, you make both Sītā and myself grieve.

sa: एतदस्य धनुर्भग्नमेते चास्य शरास्तथा। अयमस्य रणे राम भग्नः सांग्रामिको रथः॥
en: This is his snapped bow and these are his broken shafts. And this is his war-car, O Rāma shattered in fight.

sa: तमतिक्रम्य शैलेन्द्रं हेमगर्भ महागिरिम्। ततः सुदर्शनं नाम पर्वतं गन्तुमर्हथ ॥
en: Having passed beyond that mighty mountain containing gold in its womb, it behoves you to go to the mountain called Sudarsana.

sa: इह तिष्ठाद्य सुग्रीव बिलद्वारि समाहितः। यावदत्र प्रविश्याहं निहन्मि समरे रिपुम्॥
en: Do you, O Sugriva, carefully stay at the mouth of the hole, while I entering in, slay my foe in battle.

sa: क्षुद्रकर्मा हि कैकेयी द्वेषादन्यायमाचरेत्। परिदद्याद्धि धर्मज्ञ गरं ते मम मातरम्॥
en: Kaikeyi is surely mean-minded, she perpetrates wrongs from malice. O you cognizant of virtue, she may administer poison to my mother.

sa: तत्र वैश्रवणो राजा सर्वलोकनमस्कृतः। धनदो रमते श्रीमान् गुह्यकैः सह यक्षराट्॥
en: There king Vaiśravana, the lord of Yakşas, bowed down to by all creatures,-the graceful giver of riches—sporteth along with the Guhyakas.

sa: दुपायनं चोपहृतं महार्हम्। स पादुकाभ्यां प्रथमं निवेद्य चकार पश्चाद्भरतो यथावत्॥
en: And the graceful Bharata, Having installed the sandals of the noble one, always carried on the government in subordinations to them.

sa: भरतः शिरसा कृत्वा संन्यासं पादुके ततः। अब्रवीद् दुःखसंतप्तः सर्वं प्रकृतिमण्डलम्॥
en: Then bowing to the sandals which represented the trust. Bharata burning in grief addressed the entire body of the subjects, saying.

sa: तस्य दक्षिणमन्वागात् कौसल्या बाहुमङ्गना। परं चास्यान्वगात् पार्श्व कैकेयी सा सुमध्यमा॥
en: Then (raising him up), Kausalyā held his right arm and walked with him, while the slenderwaisted Kaikeyi walked by his left.

sa: काल्यमेतेन संग्रामं करिष्यसि च वानर। वीर ते शत्रुबाहुल्यं फल्गुता वा न विद्यते॥ सहसा तव निष्कामो मम तावन्न रोचते। श्रूयतामभिधास्यामि यनिमित्तं निवार्यते॥
en: O monkey chief, do you engage with him in conflict, tomorrow. O hero, your enemy is very insignificant and hence there will be no deterioration on your part. Your hastily issuing out does not please me; do you hear, why I do prevent you.

sa: पतिहीना तु या नारी कामं भवतु पुत्रिणी॥ धनधान्यसमृद्धापि विधवेत्युच्यते जनैः।
en: A husbandless woman is always styled by the wise as widow, although she might have a son and enough of riches.

sa: अष्टौ वर्षसहस्राणि तेनास्मिन्नृषिणा गिरौ। वसतो मम धर्मज्ञे स्वर्गते तु निशाकरे॥
en: After Niśākara cognizant of virtue had gone to heaven, I bereft of that saint, passed eight thousand years in this mountain.

sa: सदृशं शारदस्येन्दोः फुल्लस्य कमलस्य च॥ सुगन्धि मम रामस्य धन्या द्रक्ष्यन्ति ये मुखम्। निवृत्तवनवासं तमयोध्यां पुनरागतम्॥ द्रक्ष्यन्ति सुखिनो रामं शुक्रं मार्गगतं तथा।
en: Blessed are they that shall behold that fragrant face of his like to the autumnal moon, or the fullblown lotus. Thrice-blessed they who with delighted hearts, shall behold Rāma returned from the forest and come back to Ayodhyā, like to Sukra crowning the zenith?

sa: स ददर्श ततस्तस्या वृत्तावूरू सुसंहतौ। स्तनौ च पीनौ सहितौ सुजातं चारु चाननम्॥ तां बलादायतश्रोणी तनुमध्यां यशस्विनीम्। दृष्ट्वैव शुभसर्वाङ्गी पवनः काममोहितः॥ स तां भुजाभ्यां दीर्घाभ्यां पर्यष्वजत मारुतः। मन्मथाविष्टसर्वाङ्गो गतात्मा तामनिन्दिताम्॥
en: He had a sight of her and fine face, together with her well-developed breasts. As soon as the Wind saw that illustrious one of spacious and slender waist, and whose every limb was lovely,-was amain overcome by desire. And all his frame sessed by Manmatha, and deprived of self, the Wind emced that blameless one by means of his long arms.

sa: तोरणं दक्षिणार्धेन जम्बूप्रस्थं समागमत्। वरूथं च ययौ रम्यं ग्रामं दशरथात्मजः॥
en: Then proceeding by the south of Toraņa, he came to Jambuprastha. Then Dasaratha's son went to the beautiful village of Varūtha.

sa: तं तु तारा परिष्वज्य स्नेहाद् दर्शितसौहृदा। उवाच त्रस्तसम्भ्रान्ता हितोदर्कमिदं वचः॥
en: Embracing him warmly and showing her affection, Tara, afraid and mortified, addressed him with the following words, presaging his future welfare.

sa: त्वया तस्य निरस्तस्य पीडितस्य विशेषतः। इहैत्य पुनराह्वानं शङ्कां जनयतीव मे॥
en: That one, who had been defeated and harassed by you formerly, is now calling you. Indeed it has excited my fear.

sa: पश्यन् धातुसहस्राणि रम्याणि विविधानि च। प्रययौ तस्य पाइँन ससैन्यो भरतस्तदा॥
en: And beholding various kinds of beautiful minerals by thousand. Bharata accompanied by his army went by the side (of the hill).

sa: तां मालां काञ्चनीं दत्त्वा दृष्ट्वा चैवात्मजं स्थितम्। संसिद्धः प्रेत्यभावाय स्नेहादङ्गदमब्रवीत्॥
en: And conferring (upon Sugrīva) that golden garland and beholding his son before him, Vāli, resolved upon death, spoke to Angada, saying.

sa: एवं निश्चित्य मनसा भूय एव महातपाः॥ तपश्चचार धर्मात्मा काकुत्स्थ परमात्मवान्।
en: Ascertaining this in his mind, that righteous one of high austerities, O Kākutstha, again engaged in penances with a composed self.

sa: क्षत्रियो याजको यस्य चण्डालस्य विशेषतः॥ कथं सदसि भोक्तारो हविस्तस्य सुरर्षयः। ब्रह्मणा वा महात्मानो भुक्त्वा चाण्डालभोजनम्॥ कथं स्वर्गं गमियन्ति विश्वामित्रेण पालिताः।
en: How can celestials and saints partake of offerings in the court of him that in addition to being a Chandala, has for this priest a Kşatriya? And how high-souled Brahmanas, patronised by Visvāmitra, attain to heaven, having partaken of a Candāla's fare?

sa: नाषडङ्गविदन्नास्ति नाव्रतो नासहस्रदः। नदीनः क्षिप्तचित्तो वा व्यथितो वापि कश्चन ॥
en: There was no Brāhmaṇa who was not versed in the Vedas and Vedangas, or poor-spirit, or of insane mind, or afflicted.

sa: सदृशं शतपत्रस्य पूर्णचन्द्रोपमप्रभम्। वदनं तद् वदान्याया. वैदेह्या न विकम्पते ॥
en: The countenance of that fair-speaking one resembling the lotus and comparable to the full moon in splendour, has not waxed pale.

sa: गोप्ता हि रामं सौमित्रिर्लक्ष्मणं चापि राघवः। अश्विनोरिव सौभ्रात्र तयोर्लोकेषु विश्रुतम्॥
en: Sumitrā's son protects Rāma and Rāghava protects Lakşmaņa. Their fraternal love like that of the Asvins is celebrated in the world,

sa: तान् गुणान् सम्प्रधाहमग्र्यं चाभिजनं तव। तारया प्रतिषिद्धः सन् सुग्रीवेण समागतः॥
en: And knowing your high pedigree, and all these your accomplishments I approached Sugrīva with a hostile intention, albeit prevented by Tārā.

sa: खनित्रपिटके चोभे समानयत गच्छत। चतुर्दश वने वासं वर्षाणि वसतो मम॥
en: And for me who will go to the forest and reside there for fourteen years, bring a hoe and a basket.

sa: भरतं च परिष्वज्य यौवराज्येऽभिषिच्य च। अस्मत्संतापजं दुःखं न त्वामभिभविष्यति ॥
en: When you have embraced Bharata and installed him in the kingdom, you no longer be overpowered with grief on our account.'

sa: न चाहमनुशोचामि लक्ष्मणो न च शोचति। अयोध्यायाश्च्युताश्चेति वने वत्स्यामहेति वा॥
en: Neither I nor Lakşmaņa grieve for being ejected out of Ayodhyā, or that we shall have to abide in the forest.

sa: इति भ्रातुर्वचः श्रुत्वा कुद्धस्य च विशेषतः। ततः शूर्पणखा वाक्यं सवाष्पमिदमब्रवीत्॥
en: Hearing these words of his brother, who was under the influence of extreme rage, Sūrpanakhā with tears in her eyes, said.

sa: तमेवमुक्त्वा जनको भरतं चाभ्यभाषत ॥ गृहाण पाणिं माण्डव्याः पाणिना रघुनन्दन।
en: Having addressed Lakşmaņa thus, Janaka spoke to Bharata, saying, Do you, O descendant of Raghu, take Mandavya's hand by yours own.

sa: दुमशैलान्तरे पश्यन् भूयो दक्षिणतोऽपराम्। अपरां च दिशं प्राप्तो वालिना समभिदुतः॥
en: Then seeing Văli in the mountain among trees, from the south I, pursued by Vāli, betook myself to the western quarter.

sa: रामे वा भरते वाहं विशेषं नोपलक्षये। तस्मात्तुष्टास्मि यद्राजा रामं राज्येऽभिषेक्ष्यति॥
en: Difference find I none between Rāma and Bharata. Therefore, delighted am I that the king purposes installing Rāma in the kingdom.

sa: नारीणामभिपूर्णास्तु काश्चित् काश्चित्तु वाजिनाम्। काश्चित् तत्र वहन्ति स्म यानयुग्ये महाधनम्॥
en: And some of these were filled with women, and some with horses, and some conveyed cars and cattle of great value.

sa: न गन्तव्यं वनं देव्या सीतया शीलवर्जिते। अनुष्ठास्यति रामस्य सीता प्रकृतमासनम्॥
en: O you bereft of good behaviour, that noble lady, Sītā, should not go to the forest, Sītā will occupy Rāma's seat.

sa: भोजयन्ति किल श्राद्धे केचित् स्वानेव बान्धवान्। ततः पश्चात् समीक्षन्ते कृतकार्या द्विजोत्तमान्॥ तत्र ये गुणवन्तश्च विद्वांसश्च द्विजातयः। न पश्चात् तेऽभिमन्यन्ते सुधामपि सुरोपमाः॥
en: Some on the occasions of the Sradha (first) feast their own friends, and having done this, they mind the choice Brāhmaṇas. But those twice-born ones that are meritorious, learned, and like to celestials, do not at the last moment regard even viands resembling ambrosia.

sa: अथाभिवाद्य राजानं रथमारुह्य राघवः। ययौ स्वं द्युतिमद् वेश्म जनौधैः प्रतिपूजितः।॥
en: Then Rāghava, having been honoured by the multitude and saluted the sovereign, ascended a car, and repaired to his shining residence.

sa: तस्येत्थं ब्रुवतश्चिन्ता बभूव हृदि वीक्षतः। शोकार्तेनास्य शकुनेः किमिदं व्याहृतं मया॥
en: Having uttered this, he got worried within himself, What is this that I have said, afflicted with grief for the bird?

sa: खुरैरुदीरितो रेणुर्दिवं प्रच्छाद्य तिष्ठति। तं वहत्यनिलः शीघ्रं कुर्वन्निव मम प्रियम्॥
en: The dust raised by the hoofs (of horses) stands covering the sky: anon the wind bearing it away, compasses my pleasure.

sa: तस्य साध्वनुमन्यन्त नागरा विविधा जनाः। भरतस्य वचः श्रुत्वा रामं प्रत्यनुयाचतः॥
en: On hearing the words of Bharata, who was beseeching Rāma, many of the citizens expressed their approbation by exclaiming, “Excellent well!"

sa: आसेदुस्तस्य शैलस्य कोटि दक्षिणपश्चिमाम्। तेषां तत्रैव वनतां स कालो व्यत्यवर्तत॥
en: And they came to the south-western summit of the inountain. And when they sojourned there, their (appointed) term had not expired.

sa: तं कुमारं ततो जातं सेन्द्राः सह मरुद्गणाः। क्षीरसम्भावनार्थाय कृत्तिकाः समयोजयन्॥
en: And when the son was born, the deities with Indra and the Maruts enjoined upon the Křttikā stars to suckle him.

sa: स तु सीतां विचेष्टन्तीमङ्केनादाय रावणः॥ प्रविवेश पुरीं लङ्कां रूपिणीं मृत्युमात्मनः।
en: And taking Sītā on his lap, representing his own Death, who endeavoured (to liberate herself). Rāvana entered the city of Lankā.

sa: तं भोगैः सम्परित्यक्तं रामं सम्प्रेक्ष्य मातरः। आर्ता मुमुचुरश्रूणि सस्वरं शोककर्शिताः॥
en: Seeing Rāma, who had been deprived of every comfort, his mothers, overwhelmed with grief and distress, began to shed tears, lamenting.

sa: प्रतिग्रहो दातृवशः श्रुतमेतन्मया पुरा॥ यथा वक्ष्यसि धर्मज्ञ तत् करिष्यामहे वयम्।
en: A gift should be accepted, this I heard formerly. And what you say, O you cognizant of duty, will we accomplish.

sa: तत: समीक्ष्य शयने सन्नं शोकेन पार्थिवम्। कौसल्या पुत्रशोकार्ता तमुवाच महीपतिम्॥
en: Then seeing the king lying down stupified with grief, Kausalya, aggrieved for her son, spoke to the lord of earth, saying.

sa: स च सर्वान् समानीय वानरान् वानरर्षभः। दिशः प्रस्थापयामास दिदृक्षुर्जनकात्मजाम्।७१ ।।
en: Then that best of monkeys having summoned all the various monkeys, sent them in various directions in search of Janaka's daughter.

sa: सुसमृद्धां गुहां दिव्यां सुग्रीवो वानरर्षभः॥ प्रविष्टो विधिवद् वीरः क्षिप्रं राज्येऽभिषिच्यताम्।
en: Let Sugrīva, the foremost of monkeys, enter this magnificent celestial cave and do you all install him speedily on the throne.

sa: सीता पुरस्ताद् व्रजतु त्वमेनामभितो व्रज। अहं पश्चाद् गमिष्यामि गतिथेषा सुदारुणा॥
en: Let Sītā go first. do you follow her. I shall go last. Even this is the course of those in mourning.

sa: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे त्रस्ताः शब्देन महता ततः। अर्दिता यूथपा मत्ताः सयुथाद् दुद्रुवुर्दिशः॥
en: And at this time mad leaders of elephant-herds accompanied by the latter, scared by the terrible tumult, scudded on all sides.

sa: स तामभ्यवदद् विप्रः पुत्रेप्सुं पुत्रजन्मनि । तव कुक्षौ महाभागे सुपुत्रः सुमहाबलः॥ महावीर्यो महातेजा अचिरात् संजनिष्यति। गरेण सहितः श्रीमान् मा शुचः कमलेक्षणे॥
en: And that Vipra said to her, who was desiring of having a son born of her,-In your womb, O exalted one, will be speedily born an excellent son mixed up with poison, highly powerful, and exceedingly energetic, and possessed of mighty strength, and graceful.

sa: कर्दमः प्रथमस्तेषां विकृतस्तदनन्तरम्। शेषश्च संश्रयश्चैव बहुपुत्रश्च वीर्यवान्॥ स्थाणुर्मरीचिरत्रिश्च क्रतुश्चैव महाबलः। पुलस्त्यश्चाङ्गिराश्चैव प्रचेताः पुलहस्तथा ॥ दक्षो विवस्वानपरोऽरिष्टनेमिश्च राघव। कश्यपश्च महातेजास्तेषामासीच्च पश्चिमः॥
en: Listen, O Raghava. Of these, the first is Kardama, then Vikrta, and then Sesa, Sansraya, the powerful Bahuputra, Sthanu, Marici, Atri, the mighty Kratu, Pulastya, Aigiri, Praceta, Pulaha, Daksa, Vivasvat, Aristanemi, O Rāghava, and the exceedingly energetic Kasyapa. These had the west.

sa: गीतवादित्रनिर्घोषः श्रूयते जयतां वर। नदतां वानराणां च मृदङ्गाडम्बरैः सह ॥
en: Hear then, O best of conquerors, the sound of music, and the clatter of monkeys mingled with the sound of Mşdangas.

sa: राक्षसं मृगरूपेण चरन्तं कामरूपिणम्। निहत्य रामो मारीचं तूर्णं पथि न्यवर्तत॥
en: Killing the Rākṣasa, Mārīca assuming shapes at will and ranging in the shape of a deer, Rāma vended speedily his way.

sa: इत्येवं विलपंस्तत्र प्राप्य गोदावरी नदीम्। चक्रेऽभिषेकं काकुत्स्थः सानुजः सह सीतया॥
en: Having bewailed thus, Kākutstha, coming to the river Godāvarī, there performed his ablutions in company with his younger brother and Sītā.

sa: अस्माकं तु कुले पूर्व सगरस्याज्ञया पितुः। खनद्भिः सागरैर्भूमिमवाप्तः सुमहान् वधः॥
en: In our line the descendants of Sagara, at the command of their father, met with signal destruction, while digging the earth.

sa: ततोऽहं हिमवत्पार्वे वसामि नियतः सुखम्। भगिन्यां स्नेहसंयुक्तः कौशिक्यां रघुनन्दन ॥
en: And thenceforth, out of affection for my sister, Kausiki, I ever dwell happily in the vicinity of the Himavat, O Raghava.

sa: यनिमित्तमिदं तात सलिले क्रीडितं त्वया। उत्कण्ठिता ते मातेयं प्रविश क्षिप्रमाश्रमम्॥
en: Your mother, O child, was exceedingly anxious in consequence of your sporting in the waters. Do you speedily enter the asylum.

sa: न शोकपरितापेन श्रेयसा युज्यते मृतः। यदत्रान्तरं कार्यं तत् समाधातुमर्हथ ॥
en: Grief and lamentations do not tend to the welfare of the deceased. It therefore behoveth you to perform the after ceremonies.

sa: सुकुमार्या तपस्विन्या सुमन्त्र सह सीतया। राजपुत्रौ कथं पादैरवरुह्य रथाद् गतौ॥
en: How, O Sumantra, having descended from the car, the princes along with the tender and unfortunate Sītā are proceeding on foot?

sa: श्रीमतां गच्छतां तेषां स्वगृहाणि पुरात्ततः। बलानि राज्ञां शुभ्राणि प्रहृष्टानि चकाशिरे॥
en: And clad in bright apparel, the delighted Own forces belonging to those graceful kings repairing to their homes, looked exceedingly beautiful.

sa: यस्त्वयं विपुलः खड्गो गव्ये कोशे समर्पितः सहदेवस्य विद्ध्येनं सर्वभारसहं दृढम्॥
en: This huge, strong and dreadful sword, capable of bearing heavy weight and put in a sheath of cow-skin, belongs to Sahadeva.

sa: विसृज्य दूतान् दाशार्णे दुपदः शोकमूर्छितः। समेत्य भार्या रहिते वाक्यमाह नराधिपः॥
en: Having despatched messengers of the Dasharna king, king Drupada, fainting with grief, approached his wife in secret and spoke these words.

sa: ररक्ष पृथिवीं देवीं श्रीमानतुलविक्रमः। द्वेष्टारस्तस्य नैवासन्स च द्वेष्टि न कंचन॥
en: Blessed with fortune and with matchless prowess, he protected the goddess earth. He hated none and had none to hate him.

sa: व्यभिचारानरेन्द्राणां धर्मः संकीर्यते महान्। अधर्मो वर्धते चापि संकीर्यन्ते ततः प्रजाः॥
en: Virtue diminishes in strength on account of the misconduct of the kings, and sin becomes predominant. Thereon the subjects grow less.

sa: पुरा देवयुगे चैव हृष्टं सर्वं मया विभो। अरोचयन् सुराधर्मधर्म तत्यजिरेऽसुराः॥
en: O lord, I have seen all this formerly in the Deva Yuga. The celestials practised virtue whereas the Asuras practised sin.

sa: भीष्म उवाच व्यवसायं तयोस्तत्र विदित्वा त्रिदशेश्वरः। सह देवैरुपययौ लोकपालैस्तथैव च॥
en: Apprised of these determination, the king of the celestials came there, accompanied by the gods and the Regents of the world.

sa: नारद उवाच शृणु राजन्नवहितो यथा भीष्मेणधीमता। पुलस्त्यस्य सकाशाद् वै सर्वमेतदुपश्रुतम्॥
en: Narada said: O king, hear with attention what was heard by the intelligent Bhishma from Paulastya. Hear all that in detail.

sa: द्रौपद्यास्तं परिक्लेशं न ऑस्यते त्वमर्षिणौ। वृष्णयोऽथ महेष्वासाः पञ्चाला वा महौजसः॥ युधि सत्याभिसंधेन वासुदेवेन रक्षिताः। प्रधक्ष्यन्ति रणे पार्थाः पुत्राणां मम वाहिनीम्॥
en: As they are very angry at the insult upon Draupadi. And the most powerful warriors of the Vrishni race and the Panchalas of great strength and the sons of Pritha themselves guarded by Vasudeva of indomitable strength, will defeat my son's legions.

sa: श्रुत्वा च तस्य तद् वाक्यं स विप्रो भृशविस्मितः द्वितीयमिदमाश्चर्यमित्यचिन्तयत द्विजः॥
en: Hearing these words of his, the Brahmana became greatly astonished. The regenerate person went on meditating-Oh! this is the second marvel!

sa: त्वं तु मोहान्न जानीषे वायोर्बलमनन्तकम्। एवं तस्माद् गमिष्यामि सकाशं मातरिश्वनः॥
en: However, through folly, you are only unaware of the infinite power of the Wind, I shall, therefore, go to that god.

sa: इत्युत्ताः स मुनिश्रेष्ठैर्यदाह प्रपितामहः। तत् तेऽहं सम्प्रवक्ष्यामि शृणु शिष्य यथागमम्॥
en: I shall tell you. O disciple, what the Grandfather, thus addressed, said to them, according to the scriptures. Do you listen.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच समागतान् वेदविदो राज्ञश्च पृथिवीश्वरान्। दृष्ट्वा युधिष्ठिरो राजा भीमसेनमभाषत॥ उपयाता नरव्याघ्रा य एते पृथिवीश्वराः एतेषां क्रियतां पूजा पूजार्हा हि नराधिपाः॥
en: Vaishampayana said Seeing those kings-lords of Earth-all conversant with the Vedas, arrive, king Yudhishthira, addressing Bhimasena, said, O chief of men, let proper honors be paid to these kings who have come, for these foremost of men are all worthy of the highest honors.

sa: पितामहं नमस्कृत्य तद्वाक्यमभिनन्द्य च। निर्ममे योषितं दिव्यां चिन्तयित्वा पुनः पुनः॥
en: Bowing down to the Grandsire and receiving his command with reverence, he created a celestials damsel after good deal of thought.

sa: अत्यन्तवैरिणं दृप्तं दृष्ट्वा शत्रु तथागतम्। ननाद शकुनी राजंस्तपान्ते जलदो यथा॥
en: Beholding his bitter and haughty foe in that (pitiable) plight, Shakuni roared there like the clouds at the end of summer.

sa: अन्यं तु रथमास्थाय द्रोणः प्रहरतां वरः। व्यूहद्वारं समासाद्य युद्धाय समुपस्थितः॥
en: But once more your sons surrounded that foremost of car warriors. Meanwhile that foremost of smiters, Drona mounting on another car.

sa: संजय उवाच एवमुक्तस्तदा कर्णो वासुदेवेन भारत। लज्जयावनतो भूत्वा नोत्तरं किञ्चिदुक्तवान्॥
en: Sanjaya said Thus accosted by Krishna, O descendant of Bharata, Karna hung down his head in shame and made no reply.

sa: दिवसप्रतिमा राजन् बभूव रणमूर्धनि। आदित्येन यथा व्याप्तं तमो लोके प्रणश्यति॥
en: Looked as (bright as) day, O king, on the field of battle. As the sun dispels dense darkness hanging all over.

sa: करैस्तु करिणः शीघ्रं जलमादाय सत्वराः। सिषिचुः पावकं क्रुद्धाः शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः॥
en: Hundreds and thousands of elephants speedily brought water in their trunks and they scattered it over the fire in great wrath.

sa: यदि त्वनुग्रहवती बुद्धिस्ते मयि माधव। त्वामग्रतः पुरस्कृत्य भीष्मं यास्यामहे वयम्॥
en: If you are pleased to show us favour, O Madhava, then we shall go to Bhishma with yourself at our head.

sa: न ह्येतत् कारणं ब्रह्मन्नल्पं सम्प्रतिभाति मे। यद् ददाह सुसंक्रुद्धः खाण्डवं हव्यवाहनः॥ एतद् विस्तरशो ब्रह्मञ्छ्रोतुमिच्छामि तत्त्वतः। खाण्डवस्य पुरा दाहो यथा समभवन्मुने॥
en: When Agni consumed the Khandava in wrath, there was certainly a grave cause for it. I desire to hear from you all this in detail. O Rishi, tell me why the Khandava (forest) was consumed (by fire) in the days of yore.

sa: सूताश्वध्वजं तस्य स्यन्दनं तं च मारिष। आचितं समपश्याम श्वाविधं शललैरिव॥
en: Then, O sire, we beheld Abhimanyu;s car and driver and his standard, covered with arrows, as if by flights of locusts.

sa: अनाद्यन्ता तु सा तृष्णा अन्तर्देहगता नृणाम्। विनाशयति भूतानि अयोनिज इवानलः॥
en: This thirst has neither beginning nor end. Like the fire of incorporeal origin, it destroys creatures by living within their hearts.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच तथानुशिष्टः प्रययौ दुपदेन महात्मना। पुरोधा वृत्तसम्पन्नो नगरं नागसाह्वयम्॥
en: Vaishampayana said Being instructed in this way by the noblehearted Drupada the priest went to the city called after the elephant.

sa: यानि मिथ्याभिशस्तानां पतन्त्यश्रूणि रोदताम्। तानि पुत्रान् पशून् नन्ति तेषां मिथ्याभिशंसनात्॥
en: The tears shed by weeping men afflicted with falsehood kill the children and animals of those that have uttered those lies.

sa: संजय उवाच दृष्ट्वा तु संनिवृत्तांस्तान् संशप्तकगणान् पुनः। वासुदेवं महात्मानमर्जुनः समभाषत॥
en: Sanjaya said Beholding the host of the Samsaptakas one more return to battle, Arjuna thus addressed the high-souled son of Vasudeva.

sa: तथा देवनिकायानां महर्षीणां च सर्वशः। मुखानि चाभ्यवर्तन्त येन याति तिलोत्तमा॥
en: All the celestials and the Rishis turned their faces to that direction where Tilottama went in her walking round the assembly.

sa: स कथंचिद् भयात् तस्माद् विमुक्तो ब्राह्मणस्तथा। कांदिग्भूतो जीवितार्थी प्रदुद्रोवात्तरां दिशम्॥
en: Somehow escaping from the great danger, the Brahmana fled towards the north for saving his life, not knowing where he went.

sa: काल्यमानं बलं दृष्ट्वा धमराजो युधिष्ठिरः॥ स्वान् योधानब्रवीत् क्रुद्धो निघ्नतैतान् किमासत।
en: Then beholding his own army slain the pious king Yudhishthira said to his own warriors-"Kill them; why do you sit idle?"

sa: पुरोहिताय धौम्याय प्रादादयुतशः स गा:। धनं सुवर्ण रजतं वासांसि विविधान्यपि॥
en: He gave to his priest Dhaumya kine in thousands, and immense wealth and gold and silver and dresses of various kinds.

sa: कथ्यमाने तथा रम्ये नगरे वारणावते। गमने पाण्डुपुत्राणां जज्ञे तत्र मतिर्नुप॥
en: O king, while they were speaking of the charming city of Varanavata, the Pandavas desired in their mind to go there.

sa: ययोस्ते नामनी राजन् हंसेति डिम्भकेति च। पूर्वं संकथितं पुम्भिर्नृलोके लोकसत्कृते॥
en: O king, they were formerly called by the ever renowned names of Hansa and Dimbhaka by every body in the world.

sa: श्वभ्यश्च श्वपचेभ्यश्च वयोभ्यश्चावपेद् भुवि। वैश्वदेवं हि नामैतत् सायं प्रातश्च दीयते॥
en: By scattering morning and evening food on the earth for dogs, Chandalas and birds, a person should perform the Vishvadeva (sacrifice).

sa: संजय उवाच एवं दुर्योधने राजन् गर्जमाने मुहुर्मुहुः। युधिष्ठिरस्य संक्रुद्धो वासुदेवोऽब्रवीदिदम्॥
en: Sanjaya said While Duryodhana, O king, was repeatedly crying aloud in this way, Vasudeva, worked up with wrath, said to Yudhishthira.

sa: भीष्म उवाच अत्र ते वर्तयिष्येऽहमितिहासं पुरातनम्। साध्यानामिह संवादं हंसस्य च युधिष्ठिर॥
en: Bhishma said Regarding it I shall recite to you an old narrative, O Yudhishthira, of the discourse between the Sadhyas and a Swan.

sa: त्यजन्ति दारान् पुत्रांश्च मनुष्याः परिपूजिताः। संग्रहश्चैव भूतानां दानं च मधुरा च वाक्॥ अप्रमादश्च शौचं च राज्ञो भूतिकरं महत्। एतेभ्यश्चैव मान्धातः सततं मा प्रमादिथाः॥
en: If men are treated with honour, they can abandon their very wives and sons. By winning over good men, by gifts, sweet words, carefulness, and purity of conduct, a king may acquire for himself great prosperity. Do not, therefore, O Mandhatri, be negligent of these qualities and acts.

sa: शौनक उवाच ये सर्पाः सर्पसत्रेऽस्मिन्पतिता हव्यवाहने। तेषां नामानि सर्वेषां श्रोतुमिच्छामि सूतज॥
en: Shaunaka said: O son of Suta, I desire to hear the names of those snakes, that fell into the fire of the Snakesacrifice.

sa: सा तस्मै विधिवत् पूजां चक्रे धर्मपरायणा। स्वागतेनागतं कृत्वा किं करोमीति चाब्रवीत्॥
en: Always attentive to the duties of hospitality, she adored the guest with due rites, and welcoming him, said,-What can I do for you?

sa: एतां बुद्धिं समास्थाय सुखमास्ते गुणान्वितः। सर्वान् कामान् जुगुप्सेत कामान् कुर्वीत पृष्ठतः॥
en: Thus knowing an intelligent and wise man lives at ease. A person should renounce all his desires, and never give way to anger.

sa: तत् तस्य वचनं श्रुत्वा रूपिणी धर्मवत्सला। दर्शयामास तं विप्रं नागपत्नी पतिव्रता॥
en: Hearing these words, the chaste wife of the Naga, endued with great beauty and devoted to the observance of all duties, showed herself.

sa: कथं न राजवंशोऽयं नश्येत् प्राप्य सुतान् मम्। पाण्डोरिति मया पुत्रास्तस्मादुद्धर्षणं कृतम्॥
en: I instilled courage into your hearts, O my sons, so that the family of Pandu, represented by my children, might not be lost.

sa: हाहाकारं च कुर्वाणाः पृथिव्यां शेरते परे॥ तान् बुद्ध्वा रणमत्तोऽसौ द्रोणपुत्रो व्यपोथयत्।
en: Uttering cries of lamentation others dropped down on the Earth. In the thick of the battle Drona's son, recognising them, killed them all.

sa: तं किरन्ति महात्मानं वन्यैः पुष्पैः सुगन्धिभिः। स्त्रियः पथि समागम्य सर्वभूतहिते रतम्॥
en: Women coming out on the highways threw on the great-souled one attached to the good of all creatures wild flowers of great fragrance.

sa: कर्णो हि यदवोचत् त्वां तेजः संजननाय तत्। आचार्यपुत्रः क्षमतां महत् कार्यमुपस्थितम्॥
en: What Karna said to you was for inciting our energy. The preceptor's son should forgive us for a very important business is present.

sa: आत्मयोगाश्च तस्मिन् वै शास्त्रयोगाश्च शाश्वताः॥ एवं देवा यजन्तो हि सिद्धाश्च परमर्षयः।
en: In him are eternally present Atma Yuga and the undeteriorating Sashtra Yoga. The celestials, the Sidhas and the foremost sages all adore him.

sa: शल्य उवाच एवमुक्तस्तु नहुषः प्राहृष्यत् तदा किल। उवाच वचनं चापि सुरेन्द्रस्तामनिन्दिताम्॥
en: Shalya said Nahusha, being thus spoken to became well pleased and the king of the gods said these words to that blameless one.

sa: प्राणापानौ तथोदानं समानं व्यानमेव च। एवं तौ मनसि स्थाप्य दधतुः प्राणयोर्मनः॥
en: Fixing the vital airs Prana, Apana Samana, Udana, and Vyana in the heart, they fixed the mind in Prana and Apana united together.

sa: अथ तां वयसि प्राप्ते दासीनां समलंकृताम्। शतं शतं सखीनां च पर्युपासच्छचीमिव॥
en: And when she attained to age, hundreds and hundreds of female servants and hand-raids, decked in ornaments, waited on her like Sachi herself.

sa: इदमिन्द्रः सदा दावं खाण्डवं परिरक्षति। न च शक्रोम्यहं दग्धुं रक्ष्यमाणं महात्मना॥
en: This Khandava (forest) is every protected by Indra. I always fail to consume it, because it is ever protected by that illustrious god.

sa: पिण्डं तु मध्यमं तत्र पत्नी त्वेका समश्नुते। पिण्डस्तृतीयो यस्तेषां तं दद्याज्जातवेदसि॥
en: The second ball should be given to one of the wives to eat. The third ball should be thrown into the burning fire.

sa: स गत्वा त्वरितं राजन् दुर्योधनमते स्थितः। यथोक्तं राजपुत्रेण सर्वं चक्रे पुरोचनः॥
en: O king, ever obedient to Duryodhana, he went without loss of time. Purochana did all that the prince said, (asked him to do).

sa: अत्र गाथा: कीर्तयन्ति पुराकल्पविदो जनाः। अम्बरीषेण या गीता राज्ञा पूर्वं प्रशाम्यता॥
en: About it, persons conversant with ancient cycles recite some verses which were sung formerly by king Ambarisha who had acquired a tranquil soul.

sa: सौतिरुवाच एवमुक्तः स राजर्षिर्मन दग्धं हि तक्षकम्। हुताशनमुखे दीप्ते प्रविष्टमिति सत्तम॥
en: Sauti said : O excellent one, thus addressed, that royal sage thought Takshaka already thrown into the blazing fire and burnt to ashes.

sa: युधिष्ठिरैवं सर्वेषु न स्पृहां कर्तुमर्हसि। धर्मेण यदि ते कार्यं विमुक्तेच्छो भवार्थतः॥
en: O Yudhishthira, you should not covet anything. It you want to acquire virtue, free yourself from all desires for the possession of wealth.

sa: राजा तु धृतराष्ट्रोऽयं वयोवृद्धो न शाम्यति। मत्तः पुत्रमदेनैव विधर्मं पथि वर्तते॥
en: This king Dhritarashtra too, old in years, does not make peace, and follows the wrong path being intoxicated with the pride of sons.

sa: अस्मांस्तदेनो गच्छेद्धि कृतं वार्हद्रथ त्वया। वयं हि शक्ता धर्मस्य रक्षणे धर्मचारिणः॥
en: O son of Brihadratha, this sin, committed by you, may even touch us. We practise virtue, and we are capable of protecting virtue.

sa: पूर्वं ये चापरे तत्र समेता ब्राह्मणर्षभाः। सर्वान् सम्पूज्य शिरसा राजानं सोऽब्रवीद् द्विजः॥ फलेनानेन संयुक्तो राजर्षे गच्छ मुख्यताम्। भवता चाभ्यनुज्ञातो जपेयं भूय एव ह॥
en: He also adored all those foremost of Brahmanas that had come there by bending his head to them. Addressing the king then, he said,-Gifted with the reward of my recitation, O royal sage, acquire an eminent position. With your permission I shall set myself to my recitations again.

sa: मोहिताः परमास्त्रेण क्षयं जग्मुः परस्परम्। अशोभन्त रणे योधाः पुष्पिता इव किंशुकाः॥
en: Confounded by virtue of that weapon, they courted destruction through one another's agency. In that battle those warriors shone like flowering Kinshuka trees.

sa: देवयानी प्रजातासौ वृथाहं प्राप्तयौवना। यथा तया वृतो भर्ता तथैवाहं वृणोमि तम्॥
en: Devayani has given birth to a son. My youth is in vain. I shall choose him as my husband whom Devayani has chosen.

sa: ऋषेस्तु वचनं श्रुत्वा मामाह पुरुषर्षभः। सूत न क्वचिदेवं ते वक्तव्यं जनसंनिधौ॥
en: Hearing the words of Rsi, Dasaratha, the foremost of men, said to me, "O charioteer, do not reveal this secret to any body.

sa: विव्याध सात्यकिं तूर्णे सायकानां शतेन ह। सोऽतिविद्धो बलवता तव पुत्रेण धन्विना॥
en: He pierced Satyaki quickly with a group of hundred arrows. Pierced deeply by that great bowman endued with might, viz., your son, Satyaki.

sa: अगृह्यानुनयं तस्य मृगेन्द्रस्य च बुद्धिमान्। गोमायुः प्रायमास्थाय त्यक्त्वा देहं दिवं ययौ॥
en: Without heeding the entreaties of the king of beasts, the intelligent jackal renounced his body by sitting in Praya and went to heaven.

sa: तस्याहं लोकपालस्य वाक्यं तत्सुसमाहितः। नैव जात्वनृतं कुर्यामिति मे सौम्य दर्शनम्॥ सर्वथैव न वक्तव्यं मया सौम्य तवाग्रतः। यदि ते श्रवणे श्रद्धा श्रूयतां रघुनन्दन ॥
en: O gentle one, it is not proper by any means to falsify the words of the king Dasaratha. I shall always, very carefully, carry out his orders. It is not proper to reveal this mystery before you. Still I do so for your curiosity has been greatly excited.

sa: स विविन्ध्याय सक्रोधः समाहूय महारथः। चिक्षेप मे सुतो राजन् स गतासुरथापतत्॥
en: O king, that great car-warrior, my son, inflamed with anger, challenged Vivindha and discharged the weapon at him. He (thus struck) fell dead.

sa: नहुषेण विसृष्टा च निश्चक्राम ततः शुभा। बृहस्पतिनिकेतं च सा जगाम यशस्विनी॥
en: Shalya said Then did the beautiful one, thus dismissed by Nahusha, came out and the renowned one went to the abode of Brihaspati.

sa: एतत् त्वां मामकं तेजः समाविशति वासव। व्यग्रमेनं त्वमप्येनं वज्रेण जहि दानवम्॥
en: I give you my energy, O Vasava! The Danava has now lost his coolness. Do you, therefore, kill him now with your thunderbolt.

sa: रौद्रमस्त्रं मदीयं त्वामुपस्थास्यति पाण्डव। प्रददौ च मम प्रीत: सोऽस्त्रं पाशुपतं महत्॥
en: O Pandava, my own weapon, Rudra, shall ever be present to you.” (And) being satisfied (with me) he granted that mighty weapon, Pashupatha.

sa: न ह्येव कर्ता पुरुषः कर्मणोः शुभपापयोः। अस्वतन्त्रो हि पुरुषः कार्यते दारुयन्त्रवत्॥
en: A man is not the doer of his virtuous or impious acts. In fact a man acts under compulsion like a wooden machine.

sa: तपसा तु तथा युक्तं विश्वामित्रं पितामहः॥ अमन्यत महातेजा वरदो वरमस्य तत्।
en: The boon-giving Brahmana, of great energy, resolved to grant Vishvamitra, when he had succeeded in his ascetic observances, the boon the latter wanted.

sa: तमुवाच भरद्वाजो ज्येष्ठः पुत्रो बृहस्पतेः। पुरोधाः शीलसम्पन्नो दिवोदासं महीपतिम्॥ किमागमनकृत्यं ते सर्वे प्रब्रूहि मे नृप। यत् ते प्रिय तत् करिष्ये न मेऽत्रास्ति विचारणा।।२५
en: Seeing king Divodasa before him, the eldest son of Brihaspati, viz., Bharadvaja of excellent conduct, who was the monarch's priest, said to him What is the reason of your coming here? Tell me everything, o king! I shall do that which is agreeable to you, without any scruple.

sa: सगणं राक्षसं हत्वा नचिराद् रघुनन्दनः। त्वामादाय वरारोहे स्वां पुरीं प्रति यास्यति॥
en: And slaughtering the Rākṣasa with his own adherents, Raghu's son, O exceedingly fair one, shall ere long take you back to his palace.

sa: कीदृशं चाभवद् रूपं तस्य घोरस्य रक्षसः। स्थश्च कीदृशस्तस्य हयाः सर्वायुधानि च॥
en: What appearance did that terrible Rakshasa then assume? How looked his car and his steeds and what was the nature of his weapons?

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच तस्मिन् यज्ञे प्रवृत्ते तु वाग्मिनो हेतुवादिनः। हेतुवादान् बहूनाहुः परस्परजिगीषवः॥
en: Vaishampayana said When the great sacrifice of Yudhishthira began, many eloquent dialecticians started diverse propositions and disputed thereon, desirous of defeating one another.

sa: तमुवाच किमर्थं त्वमागतोऽपास्य मैथिलीम्। यदा सा तव विश्वासाद् वने विरहिता मया॥
en: When confiding myself in you, I had left Maithilī with you in the wood, why then did you go out, leaving her behind?

sa: संजय उवाच तथा तु नर्दमानं तं भीमसेनं महाबलम्। तुमुलेनैव शब्देन कर्णोऽप्यभ्यद्रवद्बली॥
en: Sanjaya said When the mighty car-warrior Bhimasena was thus roaring, the mighty Karna rushed at him, himself uttering a loud shout (in response).

sa: एष ते संजयो राजन् युद्धमेतद् वदिष्यति। एतस्य सर्वसंग्रामे न परोक्षं भविष्यति॥
en: Vyasa said ( king, this Sanjaya will describe to you this great battle. Nothing of the whole battle will remain unseen by him.

sa: भीष्म उवाच ब्राह्मणानां परिभवः सादयेदपि देवताः। ब्राह्मणांस्तु नमस्कृत्य युधिष्ठिर न रिष्यते॥
en: Bhishma said The humiliation of Brahmanas would humiliate the very celestials. By bowing to Brahmanas, one does not, O Yudhishthira, commit any fault.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच स श्वेतपर्वतं वीरः समतिक्रम्य वीर्यवान्। देशं किम्पुरुषावासं दुमपुत्रेण रक्षितम्॥
en: Vaishampayana said After having crossed the white mountains, that greatly powerful hero conquered the country of the Kimpurushas which was ruled by Drumaputra.

sa: दुर्योधनो महाराज त्रिगर्तेः सर्वतो वृतः। व्यूहमध्ये स्थितो राजन् पाण्डवान् प्रति भारत॥
en: King Duryodhana, surrounded by the Trigaretas on all sides, stood, O monarch, O Bharata, in the centre of the array facing the Pandavas.

sa: येषां च पुरुषव्याघ्रः शाईधन्वा व्यपाश्रयः। हितार्थी चापि पार्थानां कथं तेषां पराजयः॥
en: Those sons of Pritha, whose well-wisher and refuge is that wielders of Saranga bow, those sons, how could they suffer defeat in battle?

sa: विरथान् विह्वलांश्चक्रे न तु प्राणैर्व्ययोजयत्। भीमसेनेन तु वधः पुत्राणां ते प्रतिश्रुतः॥
en: He (simply) made them carless and destitute of energy, but did not deprive them of their lives. Bhimasena vowed to slay your sons.

sa: तपसा कर्शितः क्षामः क्षीणमांसास्थिशोणितः। स च लोकमिमं जित्वा लोकं विजयते परम्॥
en: Emaciated by hard asceticism and reduced in marrow, blood and flesh, such a Muni not only conquers this world, but the highest world.

sa: चितोऽग्निरुद्वहन् यज्ञं पक्षाभ्यां तान् प्रबाधते। मन्त्रैः प्रशमिता ह्येते नेष्टं मुष्णन्ति यज्ञियम्॥
en: They carry the oblations offered by the votaries by means of wings. When appeased by hymns they do not frustrate the sacrificial rites.

sa: भक्त्या मामभिजानाति यावान् यश्चास्मि तत्त्वतः। ततो मां तत्त्वतो ज्ञात्वा विशते तदनन्तरम्॥
en: By devotion he truly knows Me, truly what I am and who I am. Then knowing Me truly, he forthwith enters into Me.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवं मत्स्यस्य नगरे प्रच्छन्नाः कुरुनन्दनाः। आराधयन्तो राजानं यदकुर्वत तच्छृणु॥
en: Vaishampayana said Hear, what the descendants of Kuru did living thus disguised in the city of the Matsyas and serving the king thereof.

sa: किं कर्म तेनाचरितं तपो वा नियतव्रतः। येनासौ सह शक्रेण स्पर्द्धते सुमहायशाः॥
en: What act, what asceticism, what steady vows were performed by that greatly famous (king) that he has alone become equal to Indra? are

sa: संजय उवाच ततस्तत् पुनरावृत्तं युधिष्ठिरबलं महत्। ततो द्रोणश्च कर्णश्च परान् ममृदतुर्युधि॥
en: Sanjaya said Thereupon the mighty army of king Yudhishthira once more returned to the spot where Drona and Karna where crushing their enemies.

sa: न चाहं लक्षये कंचिद् व्यभिचारमिहात्मनः। अथ सर्वे भवन्तो मां विद्विषन्ति सराजकाः॥
en: But in this matter I do not find any unworthy conduct of myself but still all of you including the king hate me.

sa: सा निर्भिद्य भुजं सव्यं पाण्डवस्य महात्मनः॥ निपपात तदा भूमौ यथा विद्युन्नभश्च्युता।
en: That weapon, piercing through the left arm of the noble son of Pandu, fell down like flashes of lightning coursing on the ground.

sa: तस्मिन् विनिहते वीरे गदानुन्ने महासुरे। प्रविश्य महतीं सेनां योधयामास मे सुतः॥
en: When that heroic and great Asura was killed with the club, my son rushed into (enemy's) troops and began to fight with all.

sa: यच्च साम्नैव शक्येत कार्यं साधयितुं नृप। को दैवशप्तस्तत् कार्यं विग्रहेण समाचरेत्॥
en: O king, unless cursed by the celestials, who would seek to effect by means of war that which can be effected by conciliation?

sa: ते वयं वीरशयनं प्राप्स्यामो यदि संयुगे। अप्रणम्यैव शत्रूणां न नस्तप्स्यन्ति माधव॥
en: If we lie down like heroes in the battle without bowing before the enemies, then it is no matter for regret, O Madhava.

sa: ततो विमनसः सर्वे देवा वै मुनिपुङ्गव। प्रसादयन्त देवेशं तेषां प्रीतोऽभवद् भवः॥
en: Thereat, O powerful ascetic, with agitated hearts, the deities fell to propitiating that lord of the celestials, and Bhava was pleased with them.

sa: तेन मां प्रेषितं विद्धि विश्वस्तं संज्ञयानया! भूयश्चैवाह मां क्षत्ता विदुरः सर्वतोऽर्थवित्॥ कर्णं दुर्योधनं चैव भ्रातृभिः सहितं रणे। शकुनि चैव कौन्तेय विजेतासि न संशयः॥
en: By these credentials know me to have been sent by Vidura and also to be his trusted agent. Kshatta (Vidura), learned in the precepts of all religions, told me also. O son of Kunti, that you shall surely defeat in battle Karna, Duryodhana with his brothers and Sakuni.

sa: ततः समभवद् युद्धं त्रैलोक्यस्य भयंकरम्। शक्रस्य च सुरेन्द्रस्य वृत्रस्य च महात्मनः॥
en: Then the battle took place filling the three worlds with fear, between Indra the king of the gods and Vritra of great energy.

sa: यो विषादं प्रसहते विक्रमे समुपस्थिते। तेजसा तस्य हीनस्य पुरुषार्थो न सिद्ध्यति॥
en: He that, when the time is come for displaying his prowess, indulges in sorrow, growing weak in energy, fails to attain his objects.

sa: एवं ब्रुवाणस्तद् वाक्यं नलः परमदुर्मनाः। न वाष्यमशकत् सोढुं प्ररुरोद च भारत।॥
en: O Bharata, while speaking these words, Nala, afflicted with calamity, could not check the flow of his tears and began to weep bitterly.

sa: आस्थाय कौशिकान् मार्गानुत्पतन् स पुनः पुनः॥ गदानिपातं प्रज्ञाय भीमसेनं च वञ्चितम्।
en: Adopting the manoeuvre called Kaushika, and jumping up again and again, Duryodhana, properly making the fall of Bhima's mace, made the latter useless.

sa: तस्य बाणान्तराद् रक्तं बहु सुस्राव फेनिलम् । गिरेः प्रस्रवणस्येव धारणां च परिस्रवः॥ विकलः स कृतो बाणैः खरो रामेण संयुगे। मत्तो रुधिरगन्धेन तमेवाभ्यद्रवद् द्रुतम्॥
en: And blood mixed with froth gushed by the sides of the shafts, like torrents flowing from fountain in a hill* stupefied in battle by the shafts shot by Rāina, and maddened by the smell of blood Khara furiously inade for Rāma. The text varies slightly in other texts.

sa: कर्ण तु नवभिर्भीमो भित्त्वा राजन् स्तनान्तरे। ध्वजमेकेन विव्याध सायकेन शितेन ह॥
en: Karna again, O king, piercing Bhima on the centre of his chest with nine arrows, struck his enemy's standard with one sharp arrow.

sa: दिव्यान्यस्त्राणि सर्वाणि त्वयि तिष्ठन्ति भारत। न त्वाभिभवितुं शक्तो मानुषो भुवि कश्चन॥
en: "O Bharata, all the celestials weapons are with you; (therefore) no mortal on earth shall by any means be capable of conquering you.

sa: निर्मितायां च देवेन्द्र तस्यां नायाँ सुरर्षभ। भविष्यतीति कस्यैषा मम चिन्ता ततोऽभवत्।।२४
en: Having created that female I was thinking, O king of the celestials! O foremost of the deities!, on whom I should confer her.

sa: त्वं धारयसि भूतानि पृथिवीं सर्वपर्वतान्। अन्ते पृथिव्याः सलिले दृश्यसे त्वं महोरगः॥
en: You did uphold all creatures, the earth and all the mountains. You appear like the great serpent in the water underneath the earth.

sa: स तु वैवस्वतो देवैः सह ब्रह्मपुरोगमैः। जगाम त्रिदिवं हृष्टो नारदश्च महामुनिः॥
en: With a delighted heart Vaivasvata along with the deities headed by Brahmā as well as that mighty ascetic-Narada, went to the celestial regions.

sa: सुलभाः पुरुषा राजन्सततं प्रियवादिनः। अप्रियस्य च पथ्यस्य वक्ता श्रोता च दुर्लभः॥
en: O king, many are the persons who speak sweet words. hit rare are they who can speak and near anpalatable but well-meaning words.

sa: अयं तु भावो दुर्बुद्धे यस्त्वयेह प्रवर्तितः। मानुषेष्वपि लोकेषु भविष्यति न संशयः॥
en: And this vile desire, O you having a vicious intellect, which you have first created, shall undoubtedly spread in the world of mortals.

sa: ततोऽथ बुद्ध्वा स तदस्त्रबन्धं प्रभोः प्रभावाद् विगताल्पवेग: :1 पितामहानुग्रहमात्मनश्च विचिन्तयामास हरिप्रवीरः॥
en: And thinking that he was bound up with a Brahma weapon, he did not feel the least pain in consequence of Brahmā's blessing.

sa: उपस्थापय मे शीघ्रं विमानं राक्षसेश्वर। कृतकार्यस्य मे वासः कथं स्यादिह संमतः॥
en: Do you speedily bring the car for me, O lord of Räkşasas my work is done-how can I wish to live here long.

sa: रूपं च ते प्रजाः सर्वा गमिष्यन्ति न संशयः। यत्तदेकं समाश्रित्य विभ्रमोऽयमुपस्थितः॥
en: All created beings shall participate your beauty; your matchless beauty has brought about this mischief.' Thenceforward all created beings were gifted with beauty.

sa: नियुक्तो नृपतेः कार्य न कुर्याद्यः समाहितः। भृत्यो युक्तः समर्थश्च तमाहुः पुरुषाधमम्॥
en: That servant who, entrusted with any work of the king do not, although competent, heedfully accomplish the same, has been called the worst.

sa: कृतप्रसादास्तेनैवं राघवेण महात्मना। जग्मुः स्वं स्वं गृहं सर्वे देही देहमिव त्यजन्।।३०
en: Having received favours thus from the highsouled Rāghava, the monkeys went away to their own houses like-to bodied creatures leaving of their bodies.

sa: दण्ड एव परो लोके पुरुषस्येति मे मतिः। धिक्क्षमामकृतज्ञेषु सान्त्वं दानमथापि वा॥
en: In respect of the ingrate even chastisement is supreme in this world, this is my conviction. Down with forbearance, or moderation, or gift!

sa: अधर्मात् तु महोत्पातो भविष्यति हि साम्प्रतम्। नैते धर्मं विजानन्ति राक्षसाः पिशिताशनाः॥
en: Mighty is the disaster that shall arise on account of this crime—the Räkşasas who live on flesh do not know what virtue is.
