sa: ततो रामो महातेजा धनुरादाय वीर्यवान्। प्रविश्य राक्षसं सैन्यं शरवर्ष ववर्ष च॥
en: Thereupon the highly effulgent and powerful Rāma, taking up his bow, entered the Rākşasa host and began to make a downpour of arrows.

sa: रजसा महता चापि नक्षत्राणि हतानि च। युगान्तमिव लोकानां पश्य शंसन्ति लक्ष्मण।।१०
en: The stars seem crased by a mighty volume of dust. O Lakşmaņa, behold this sight disastrous to people like to the universal dissolution.

sa: तदवस्थां च तां दृष्ट्वा महात्मा नलकूबरः॥ अब्रवीत्किमिदं भद्रे पादयोः पतितासि मे।
en: Having seen her in that plight the high-souled Nalakubara said-"O fair one, what is this? Why have you placed yourself at my feet?”

sa: ततो वानरराजेन लक्ष्मणेन च पूजितः। जगाम रामो धर्मात्मा ससैन्यो दक्षिणां दिशम्॥
en: Thereafter, honoured by the king of monkeys and also Laksmana, the righteous Rāma, accompanied by his forces, set out in a southerly direction.

sa: एहीदानी कृतं यद्धिसुकृतं तन्त्र संशयः। आगच्छ सौम्य गच्छामः स्वमेव भवनं प्रति॥
en: However, what is done is done, there is virtue in this, no doubt; come, o gentle one, we shall go to our house.

sa: येनाद्य बहवो युद्धे निहता राक्षसाः क्षितौ। तस्यामेवाद्य शूरस्त्वं शेषे विनिहतः शरैः॥
en: You, O hero, who had in battle slain innumerable Rākṣasa lying around, have (at length) yourself been slain in the field with shafts.

sa: स च हन्ता विराधस्य कबन्धस्य खरस्य च। सुग्रीवसहितो रामः सीतायाः पदमागतः॥
en: The same Rāma that has slain Virādha and Kabandha and Khara, has arrived (here) along with Sugrīva, searching for the whereabouts of Sītă.

sa: बालवृद्धावशेषां तु लङ्कां कृत्वा शरोमिभिः। रावणं तु रिपुं हत्वा सीतां त्वपमुलप्स्यसे॥
en: And with the surges of your shafts, making Larkā contain only children and aged, and slaying your foe, Ravana, you shall recover Sita.

sa: इदं तत्तव रामस्य कार्मुकं ज्यासमावृतम्। इह प्रहस्तेनानीतं तं हत्वा निशि मानुषम्॥
en: This is Rāma's. This is the bow of your Rāma with the string fixed. Slaying that man over night, Prahasta brought it hither.

sa: चतुर्दश सहस्राणि राक्षसानां जघान यः। जनस्थाने विना भ्रात्रा शत्रुः कस्तस्य नोद्विजेत्॥
en: He brought about without his brother's aid, the destruction of the fourteen thousand Rākṣasas at Janasthāna. What enemy is not troubled at this?

sa: ततो गदां समाविध्य माणिभद्रेण राक्षसः। धूम्राक्षस्ताडितो मूर्ध्नि विह्वलः स पपात ह॥
en: Then Mänibhadra dealt the Raksasa a blow with his mace; and thereat Dhūmrākṣa smite at the head fell down senseless (on the ground).

sa: एवं श्रुत्वा महाबाहुस्तमृर्षि प्रत्युवाच सः। कीदृशं लक्षणं तस्य बूहि सर्वमशेषतः॥ राक्षसेशवचः श्रुत्वा स मुनिः प्रत्यभाषत। श्रूयतां सर्वमाख्यास्ये तव राक्षसपुंगव॥ स हि सर्वघतो देवः सूक्ष्मोऽव्यक्तः सनातनः। तेन सर्वमिदं व्याप्तं त्रैलोक्यं सचराचरम्॥ स भूमौ दिवि पाताले पर्वतेषु वनेषु च। स्थावरेषु च सर्वेषु नदीषु नगरीषु च॥ ओङ्कारचैव सत्यश्च सावित्री पृथिवी च सः। धराधरधरो देवो हनन्त इति विश्रुतः॥
en: Hearing this the long-armed (Ravana) again said to the ascetic:-"Do you tell me at length what are his marks." Hearing the words of the lord of Raksasas, the ascetic replied:-"Hearken, I shall relate to you every thing, O foremost of Raksasas. That great deity pervade all, is minute, invisible ever-existing, and manifest over the universe consisting of mobile and immobile creations. He is present in the celestials region, in the earth, in the region underneath the earth, on the mountains, in the forests, in all stationary objects, in all rivers and in all cities. He is Om, truth, Sāvitri and earth. He is known as the deity Dharādhara (holder of earth) and Ananta.

sa: तत्त्वं बुद्धिमतां श्रेष्ठः सर्वशा स्वार्थकोविदः। मद्विधैः सचिवैः सार्धमरिं जेतुं समर्हसि ॥
en: Therefore, the foremost of intelligent persons, and conversant with every lore, you should along with councillors like me, strive to beat they foe.

sa: सुखं पश्यथ दुर्धर्षा युद्धं वानरपुङ्गवाः। आसीनाः पर्वताग्रेषु ममेदं रावणस्य च ॥
en: Do you, you irrepressible ones, you foremost of monkeys, seated at the brow of the mountain, behold the battle between me and Rāvaņa.

sa: कायवृद्धिं प्रवेगं च मम दृष्ट्वैव राक्षसाः। मयि कौतूहलं कुर्युरिति मेने महामतिः॥
en: Soon as the Rākṣasas shall behold my enlarged body and the vehemence of my motion, they shall be seized with curiosity concerning me.

sa: रावणस्य वचः श्रुत्वा गुणदोषौ विमृश्य च। पश्चादपि महाबाहो शत्रून्युधि विजेष्यसि ॥
en: O long-armed one, having at first heard Rāvana's words and considered their justice or otherwise, you will afterwards defeat the foe in fight.

sa: रावणो नो निहन्तव्यः सर्वे च रजनीचराः। इति गर्जन्ति हरयो राघवस्य समीपतः॥
en: We shall slay Rāvana, as also all the rangers of the night'; thus did the monkeys, roar out in the presence of Rāghava.

sa: स तस्य मधुपर्क गां पाद्यमध्यं निवेद्य च। पुलस्त्यमाह राजेन्द्रो हर्षगद्गदया गिरा।।।
en: Thereupon offering him Madhuparka, cow and water to wash feet, the king of Haihayas, in accents obstructed with delight, addressed the ascetic saying

sa: सीतानिमित्तं राज्ञस्तु रावणस्य दुरात्मनः। रक्षसां चैव सर्वेषां विनाशः समुपागतः। ४९ ।।
en: The destruction of the unrighteous king Rāvaņa together with all the Rākşasas, has come about in consequence of Şītā (having been carried away).

sa: ततोऽवघोषय पुरे गजस्कन्धेन पार्थिव। हतो रामः सह भ्रात्रा ससैन्य इति सर्वतः॥
en: Then, O king, do you through Gajaskandha publish it all round that Ráma has been slain along with his brother and the army.

sa: भ्रातुरादेशमाज्ञाय लक्ष्मणो वा परंतपः॥ स किमर्थं नरवरो न मां रक्षति राघवः।
en: And obtaining the behests of his brother, why dose not Lakşmaņa, the subduer of foes and best of men, protect me, O Rāghava?

sa: एवमुक्ता महात्मानो वानरा वारणोपमाः। उत्पेतुर्गगनं शीघ्रं गरुडा इव शीघ्रगाः। ५१ ।।
en: Being thus addressed by the high-souled (Sugrīva) the monkeys resembling the elephants speedily rose up in the welkin like to quick coursing vultures.

sa: यदि चेत्त्वं तु मां दर्पान्नाभिनन्दसि गर्विते। द्विमासानन्तरं सीते पास्यामि रुधिरं तव॥
en: If, O haughty one, you do not honour me from pride of heart, I shall, O Sītā, two months hence, see your blood.

sa: तस्य क्रुद्धस्य वदनं दृष्ट्वा रामस्य धीमतः।। सर्वभूतानि वित्रेसुः प्राकम्पत च मेदिनी॥
en: Seeing the face of the enraged Rāma endued with under standing all the creatures were overwhelmed with fear and the Earth herself shook.

sa: तद्विशीर्णं गिरेः शृङ्गं दृष्ट्वा हरिचमूपतिः। कालाग्निरिव जज्वाल कोपेन वरवीरहा। ७४ ।।
en: Seeing that mountain peak shattered, that general of the monkey-forces-slayer of hostile heroes-flamed up in wrath like the fire at the universal wreck.

sa: तेन ते वारुणा युद्धे कानगाः पवनोपमाः। महोदरेण गदया हतास्ते प्रययुः क्षितिम्॥
en: And smit with his mace by Mahodara, Varuna's sons coursing at will and resembling the wind in velocity) dropped down to the ground.

sa: स विह्वलस्तु तेजस्वी वातोद्भूत इव दुमः॥ लाक्षारससवर्णं च सुस्राव रुधिरं महत्।
en: Thereupon that strong one overwhelmed like a tree buffeted by the wind, began to discharge blood profusely, looking like the hue of lac.

sa: दत्त्वा तु तनयां राजा स्वमाश्रमपदं गतः। सापि तत्रावसत्कन्या तोषयन्ती पतिं गुणैः॥
en: Having given away his daughter, the king went (back) to his asylum; and the girl stayed there, gratifying her husband with her virtues.

sa: वत्स रावण तुष्टोऽस्मि पुत्रस्य तव संयुगे। अहोऽस्य विक्रमौदार्य तव तुल्योऽधिकोऽपि वा।।३
en: My son, Ravana, I have been pleased with your son in the conflict. Oh! what wonderful prowess, what strength-equal or greater than your.

sa: एवमुक्तः सुरसया दशयोजनमायतः॥ ततोऽर्धगुणविस्तारो बभूवाहं क्षणेन तु। मत्प्रमाणाधिकं चैव व्यादितं तु मुखं तया।॥ तद् दृष्ट्वा व्यादितं त्वास्यं ह्रस्वं ह्यकरवं पुनः। तस्मिन्मुहूर्ते च पुनर्बभूवाङ्गुष्ठसम्मितः॥ अभिपत्याशु तद्वक्त्रं निर्गतोऽहं ततः क्षणात्। अब्रवीत्सुरसा देवी स्वेन रूपेण मां पुनः॥
en: Having been thus addressed by Surasa, attained the magnitude of ten Yoyanas; and then anon I dilated to another ten. But she opened her mouth wider than my magnitude. Seeing her stretched mouth, I again diminished myself, and on the instant again reduced myself to the measure of a thumb. And speedily entering her mouth, I immediately came out. Then the exalted Surasă again spoke to me in her native shape.

sa: येषां नोपरि नाधस्तान्न तिर्यक् सज्जते गतिः। न च कर्मसु सीदन्ति महत्स्वमिततेजसः॥
en: Their course is never thwarted-whether going upwards or downwardsor moving tortuously. They are never exhausted in their actions—highly courageous and of measureless prowess.

sa: बालैरपि भवन्तस्तैः सर्व एव विशेषिताः। एतत् सैन्यं समासाद्य सर्व एव बलोत्कटाः॥
en: Even as children there was great difference between yourself and them. They, all of whom are endued with fierce strength, meeting this army,

sa: ततो वामनकं गच्छेत् त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुतम्। तत्र विष्णुपदे स्नात्वा अर्चयित्वा च वामनम्॥ सर्वपापविशुद्धात्मा विष्णुलोकं स गच्छति। कुलम्पुने नरः स्नात्वा पुनाति स्वकुलं ततः॥
en: One should then go to Vamanaka, celebrated over the three worlds. Bathing there in the Vishnupada and worshipping Vamana. One, being free from all his sins and his soul being purified goes to the region of Vishnu. Bathing in the Kulampuna one purifies his own race.

sa: निद्रार्तमर्धरात्रे च तथा नष्टप्रणायकम्॥ भिन्नयोधं बलं यच्च द्विधा युक्तं च यद् भवेत्। इत्येवं निश्चयं चक्रे सुप्तानां निशि मारणे॥ पाण्डूनां सह पञ्चालैोणपुत्रः प्रतापवान्।
en: They shouid be equally treated when sleeping at dead of night, or when reft of commanders, or when routed, or when labouring under an error.'-Having thought thus, the valiant son of Drona formed the resolution of killing during the night the sleeping Pandavas and the Panchalas,

sa: उवाच सुमहात्मानं वर्धयित्वा कृताञ्जलिः। द्रष्टुमिच्छति राजा त्वां गम्यतां तत्र मा चिरम्॥
en: And having saluted him, with folded palms he said to the high-souled Laksmana and:-"The King wishes to behold you-do you soon go there.

sa: न हि जात्ववमन्तव्यो मनुष्य इति भूमिपः। महती देवता ह्येषा नररूपेण तिष्ठति॥
en: No one should obey the king by taking him for a man, for he is in sooth a great god in human form.

sa: साहाय्यं धार्तराष्ट्रस्य न च कर्तास्मि केशव। न चैव पाण्डुपुत्राणां गमिष्यामि यथागतम्॥
en: He had said to Keshava-"I will help neither the son of Dhritarashtra nor the sons of Pandu, but will go wherever I like."

sa: वक्तुं न शक्तो रामस्य गुणान्कश्चिन्नरः क्षितौ। जनस्थानगता येन तावन्तो राक्षसा हताः॥
en: No person can on earth describe the virtues of Rāma; by whom have been slain all those Rākşasas that had gone to Janasthāna.

sa: वालिजेन तु दुःखेन पीडिता शोककर्शिता। पञ्चत्वमागता राज्ञी तारापि न भविष्यति ॥
en: And oppressed with grief arising from Vāli, and weighed down by sorrow, the queen Tārā, also, resolving on death shall cease to exist.

sa: ततश्छित्त्वा च पाशान् वेगवान् वै महाकपिः॥ उत्पपाताथ वेगेन ननाद च महाकपिः।
en: Thereat that vehement and mighty monkey snapped his bonds, and furiously springing into the sky, the terrible monkey uttered a shout. anon one

sa: नमोऽस्तु स्थाणवे नित्यं नमस्तस्मै तपस्विने॥ नमोऽस्तु त्रिपुरनाय भगनाय च वै नमः।
en: Salutations to Sthanu, to that best of all wielders of bow, salutations even to the destroyer of 'Tripura,' and the slayer of Bhaga.

sa: एवमुक्त्वा तं राम भुजान्विक्षिप्य पर्वते। तोलयामास तं शीघ्रं स शैलं समकम्पत॥
en: Having said this, O Rama, Ravana seizing the mountain with his arms, lifted it up at once; and then the mountain trembled greatly.

sa: समीक्षा यादृशी ह्यस्य पाण्डवान् प्रति भारत। उपेक्ष्यमाणा स राजन् महान्तमनयं स्पृशेत्॥
en: O descendant of Bharata, he (Duryodhana) looks towards the Pandavas with such jealousy that unless you interfere, great harm will be the consequence.

sa: न चास्य प्रतिबन्धेन देयोऽग्निरपि केशिनि। याचते न जलं देयं सर्वथा त्वरमाणया॥
en: O Keshini, whenever he may ask fire or water, you will not be in a hurry to give it; and thus obstruct him.

sa: निमीलिताभ्यां नेत्राभ्यां बलाद् देवो महेश्वरः। ललाटे नेत्रमसृजत् तेन त्र्यक्षः स उच्यते॥
en: Shutting his two, eyes, that Potent Lord created a third on his forehead by sheer force; and therefore is he called the Three-eyed.

sa: शङ्ख उवाच ततस्तमब्रवीच्छङ्खस्तपसेदं कृतं मया। मा च तेऽत्र विशङ्काभूद् दैवमत्र विधीयते॥
en: Shankha said All this has been done by me through my penances! Do not be surprised at it. Providence is the instrument here.

sa: भ्रातुः समीपे शोकार्ता ससर्ज निनदं महत्। सस्वरं मुमुचे वाष्पं विवर्णवदना तदा॥
en: And in presence of her brother, she set up a mighty roar; and then her face grown pallid, she dropped tears, emitting cries.

sa: मा ह्युयत्सृज्य सुहृदः स्वधर्म स्वजनं तथा। वृतोऽयं पुरुषव्याघ्रस्तव पुत्रः पतिः शुभे॥
en: O blessed lady, leaving my friends relatives and religion, I have chosen this best of men, this son of yours, as my husband.

sa: तस्मिन् हते महाराज त्रस्तास्तस्य पुरोगमाः। गौतमं हरे त्यक्त्वा दुदुवुस्ते दिशो दश॥
en: O Emperor, when he was slain, all his followers, leaving behind the son of Gautama in the battle-field fled, away in ten directions.

sa: उवाच चोपरिचरं मया भागोऽयमुद्यतः। ग्राह्यः स्वयं हि देवेन मत्प्रत्यक्षं न संशयः॥
en: Addressing king Uparichara he said,-Here, I place this as Narayana's share of the sacrificial offerings! Forsooth, he shall take it before my eyes.

sa: ते स्मरन्तः परिक्लेशान् वर्षे पूर्णे त्रयोदशे। विमोक्ष्यन्ति विषं क्रुद्धाः कौरवेयेषु भारत॥
en: O descendant of Bharata, on the expiration of the thirteenth year, recollecting all their woes, they may shower virulent poisons on the Kurus.

sa: स्वबाहुबलमाश्रित्य योऽभ्युज्जीवति मानवः। स लोके लभते कीर्ति परत्र च शुभां गतिम्॥
en: That son of Manu, who lives on the strength of his arms, gets renown in this world and a blissful one here after.

sa: रावणेन जनस्थानाद् बलात् प्रमथिता यदि। सीता त्वमसि भद्रं ते तन्ममाचक्ष्व पृच्छतः॥
en: Are you that Sītā, I do ask you, who had been stolen and borne away by Rāvana from Janasthāna? May good betide you!

sa: एतत् तु वचनं श्रुत्वा कैकेय्या समुदाहृतम्। उवाच व्यथितो रामस्तां देवी नृपसंनिधौ॥
en: Hearing these words uttered by Kaikeyī, Rāma, pained at heart, spoke to her in the presence of the king in the following way:

sa: स हि देवरसंयुक्तो मम भर्ता महाद्युतिः। निर्भयो वीर्यमाश्रित्य शून्ये वसति दण्डके॥
en: That exceedingly effulgent lord of mine along with my husband's younger brother, summoning up their energy, is fearlessly dwelling in the vacant Dandaka.

sa: गच्छाद्य त्वं च स्वगृहं स्नातो दिव्यैरिमै लैः। भ्रातरस्तेऽनुतप्यन्ति त्वां विना कुरुपुङ्गव॥
en: O best of the Kuru race, bathe in this sacred and auspicious water and return home. Your brothers are disconsolate for your absence.

sa: दण्डधारौ महाराज रथ एको नरर्षभ। योत्स्यते तव संग्रामे स्वेन सैन्येन पालितः॥
en: That foremost among men, Dandadhara, O great king, is a Ratha and he will fight in your battle protected by his own army.

sa: पण्डितान् पृष्ठतः कृत्वा परेषां गुणवादिनः। विधीयतां तता नीतिर्यथा वध्यो भवेत् परः॥
en: Leaving behind the learned who speak highly of the heroism of the enemy, do you so arrange that the enemy may be killed.

sa: कथं भीमस्य वाक्यानि श्रोतुं शक्ष्यामि संजय। येन पुत्रशतं पूर्णमेकेन निहतं मम॥
en: How shall I be able, O Sanjaya, to endure the words of Bhima who has alone killed a full hundred sons of mine?

sa: यस्य वासः कुरुक्षेत्रे खाण्डवे कुरुक्षेत्रे खाण्डवे चाभवत्पुरा। तं नागराजमस्तौषं कुण्डलार्थाय तक्षकम्॥
en: In order to get beck my ear-rings I worship you, Takshaka, the Naga-king, who formerly lived in Kurukshetra and the forest of Khandhava.

sa: अद्यापि मानुषो भावः स्पृशते त्वां नराधिय। स्वर्गोऽयं पश्य देवर्षीन् सिद्धांश्च त्रिदिवालयान्॥
en: Human affections still touch you. This is Heaven. See these celestial Rishis and Siddhas who have attained to the region of the gods.'

sa: स ते वीर्यं बलं दर्पमुत्सेकं च तथाविधम्। व्यपनेष्यति गात्रेभ्यः शरवर्षेण संयुगे॥
en: By means of an arrowy shower in conflict, he will take your prowess and strength, your hauteur and wickedness out of your person,

sa: विदितश्चास्तु भद्रं ते योऽयं रणपरिश्रमः। सुतीर्णः सुहृदां वीर्यान्न त्वदर्थं मया कृतः॥
en: May good betide you-do you know that all my labour in the battle-field, backed by the prowess of my friends, is for you.

sa: व्यासोक्तं श्रूयते येन कृत्वा ब्राह्मणमग्रतः॥ स नरः सर्वकामांश्च कीर्ति प्राप्येह शौनक।
en: That man, O Shaunaka, who hears this history, placing a Brahmana before him, acquires both fame and the fruition of all his desires.

sa: ततस्तं विरथं दृष्ट्वा कृपः शारद्वतः प्रभो॥ अपोवाह ततः क्षिप्रं रथमारोप्य वीर्यवान्।
en: O Lord, Saradvat, seeing Hridika's son made carless, the valiant Kripa then, the son Saradvat of speedily carried him away, on his car.

sa: न पाण्डवानां शिबिरे कश्चित् सुष्वाप तां निशाम्। प्रजागरः सर्वजनं ह्याविवेश विशाम्पते॥
en: During that night none enjoyed sleep in the camp of the Pandavas. During that night, O ruler of men, wakefulness possessed every body.

sa: इति सर्वं समुन्नद्धं न निर्वाति कथञ्चन॥ अभिमन्योर्विनाशेन स संधेयः कथं मया।
en: Everything, therefore, is on fire. That fire can never be extinguished. Peace with them is impossible on account of the death of Abhimanyu.

sa: अयं वः फाल्गुनो भ्राता गाण्डीवं परमायुधम्। परित्यज्य वने यातु नानेनार्थोऽस्ति कश्चन॥
en: Let your brother Phalguna proceed to the forest after casting off Gandiva, that great weapon. He has no longer any necessity for it.

sa: अनयाः सम्प्रवर्तेरन् भवेद् वै वर्णसंकरः। दुर्भिक्षमाविशेद् राष्ट्रं यदि राजा न पालयेत्॥
en: In the absence of king's protection, all kinds of injustice would commence; intermixture of castes would occur; and famine would devastate the kingdom.

sa: स गत्वा निलयं राजा श्राद्धं कृत्वा विधानतः। प्रभाते काल्यमुत्थाय चक्रे गोदानमुत्तमम्॥
en: And reaching his quarters, the king performed the Srāddha according to the ordinance, arose the next morning, and made excellent gifts of kine.

sa: त्वयि सर्वे प्रदृश्यन्ते सुरा ब्रह्मादयोऽनघ। सर्वस्त्वमसि लोकानां कर्ता कारयिता च ह॥
en: O sinless one, the celestials with Brahma are displayed in you. You are everything, the creator himself and the ordainer of the world,

sa: प्यग्र्यं सुवर्ण रजतं सुसुद्धम्। अयस्मयं ताम्रमयं च भाण्डं ददौ द्विजातिप्रवरेषु रामः॥
en: Balarama also distributed to the foremost of the Brahmanas, the gems, garlands, diamonds, pure gold and silver and utensil made of iron copper.

sa: संजय उवाच एवमुक्तस्तदा सूत: शिक्षितान् साधुवाहिनः॥ शशाङ्कसंनिकाशान् वै वाजिनो व्यनुदद् भृशम्।
en: Sanjaya continued Thus spoken to, the charioteer quickly drove those well-trained steeds resembling the moon in huc and carrying the warrior Satyaki well.

sa: तां तु दृष्ट्वाद्य वैदेही पूर्णचन्द्रनिभाननाम्॥ मन्मथस्य शराणां च त्वं विधेयो भविष्यसि।
en: As soon as you have seen Vaidehi having a countenance resembling the full moon, you shall be afflicted with the shafts of Cupid.

sa: परस्परं च नक्षत्रं हन्यमानं पुनः पुनः। ग्रहैरपश्यन् सर्वे ते नात्मनस्तु कथंचन॥
en: The Constellations were repeatedly seen to be struck by the planets. None amongst the Yadavas could, however, see the constellation of his birth.

sa: शिखण्डी च ततः क्रुद्धो गौतमं त्वरितो ययौ। ववर्ष शरवर्षाणि समन्ताद् द्विजपुङ्गवम्॥
en: Thereupon Shikhandin, worked up with anger, speedily approached the son of Gautaina and discharged a shower of arrows upon that best of men.

sa: ततः सा राममभ्येत्य जननी मे महानदी। मदर्षं तमृर्षि वीक्ष्य क्षमयामास भार्गवम्॥
en: Then my mother, the great river, going to Rama and trying to entreat that Rishi, that scion of Bhrigu's race for my sake,

sa: उचितोऽयं जनः सर्वः क्लेशानां त्वं सुखोचितः। गुप्त्यर्थं जागरिष्यामः काकुत्स्थस्य वयं निशाम्॥
en: These (foresters) are inured to this hardship; but you are worthy of ease. We will wake up during the night for guarding Kākutstha.

sa: पश्य गन्धर्वराजानं धृतराष्ट्र मनीषिणम्। एनं च त्वं विजानीहि भ्रातरं पूर्वजं पितुः॥
en: Look at Dhritarashtra, the king of the Gandharva, endued with great wisdom. Know that this one was the eldest brother of your father.

sa: तेषां श्रुत्वा तु हृष्टानां वृद्धः कुरुपितामहः। सिंहनादं विनद्योच्चैः शङ्ख दध्मौ प्रतापवान्॥
en: Hearing these shouts, the greatly powerful and the venerable Kuru grandsire uttered a lion-like roar and then blew his conch in great delight.

sa: हन्त यत् ते प्रवक्ष्यामि तच्छृणुष्व समाहितः। ऋषीणां देवतानां च सम्भवं वसुधातले॥
en: Listen to what I tell you briefly. Is the Mahabharata is to be found the births of Rishis and deities on the Earth.

sa: येषां न विद्यते संख्या प्रमाणं रूपमेव च। असंख्येयगुणा रुद्रा नमस्तेभ्योऽस्तु नित्यशः॥
en: I always salute them who are without number and measure, and who have no form, those Rudras, who are gifted with infinite attributes.

sa: ब्राह्मण्यनुपमा दृष्टिः क्षात्रमप्रतिमं बलम्। तौ यदा चरतः सार्धं तदा लोकः प्रसीदति॥
en: Incomparable is the sight of a Brahmana and the might of a Kshatriyas; when they proceed in unision the whole world is delighted.

sa: गौतम्युवाच का नु प्राप्तिर्गृह्य शत्रु निहत्य का कामाप्तिः प्राप्य शत्रु न मुक्त्वा। कस्मात् सौम्याहं न क्षमे नो भुजङ्गे मोक्षार्थं वा कस्य हेतोर्न कुर्याम्॥
en: Gautami replied What good is there in torturing and destroying an enemy, and what good is acquired by not setting free an enemy in our power? Therefore. O you of kind face, why should we not forgive this serpent and try to acquire merit by setting it free.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवमुक्ता महाराज कुन्ती पाण्डुमभाषत। कुरूणामृषभं वीरं तदा भूमिपति पतिम्॥
en: Vaishampayana said : O great king, having been thus assessed Kunti replied to her heroic lord, king Pandu, the best of the Kurus.

sa: अधर्मः प्रगृहीतः स्याद् यदि राजा न पालयेत्॥ मातरं पितरं वृद्धमाचार्यमतिथिं गुरुम्।
en: In the absence of king's protection men would disobey or even injure their very parents if aged, their very preceptors, guests and elders.

sa: यावत् कालेन भवति पुत्रस्योत्पादन शुभे। तावत् कालं गमिष्यामि त्वया सह सुमध्यमे॥
en: O blessed lady, O lady of slender waist, I shall go (and stay) with you, so long you do not obtain a son."

sa: तत्र ते न्यवसन् राजन् किंचित् कालं मनस्विनः। धनुर्वेदपरा वीराः शृण्वन्तो वेदमुत्तमम्॥
en: O king, those intelligent heroes then lived there for some time, devoting themselves to the science of archery and hearing the excellent Vedas.

sa: अमित्राणामधिष्ठानाद् वधाद् दुर्योधनस्य च। भीम दिष्ट्या पृथिव्यां ते प्रथितं सुमहद् यशः॥
en: For your having defeated the foes and having slain Duryodhana, by good luck, O Bhima, your fame has extended over the whole world.

sa: भ्रातृणां चैव पुत्राणां तथा वै शोकविह्वला:॥ कथं द्रक्ष्यामि विधवा वधूः शोकपरिप्लुताः।
en: Alas, how shall I see the widows, of my brothers and sons and grandsons, all overwhelmed with grief and stricken down with sorrow.

sa: ततो दुर्योधनो राजा हतबन्यू रणाजिरात्। अपसृत्य ह्रदं घोरं विवेश रिपुजाद् भयात्॥
en: Thereupon having his allies slain king Duryodhana fled from the battlefield and was entered into a dreadful lake in fear of his enemies.

sa: स रथः सर्वतो भाति चित्रपुङ्खैः शितैः शरैः॥ उल्काशतैः सम्प्रदीप्तं विमानमिव भूतले।
en: That car shone with those keen arrows of beautiful wings like a celestial car, blazing with hundreds of torches dropped on the carth.

sa: संजय उवाच धर्मच्छलमपि श्रुत्वा केशवात् स विशाम्पते। नैव प्रीतमना रामो वचनं प्राह संसदि॥ हत्वाऽधर्मेण राजानं धर्मात्मानं सुयोधनम्। जिह्मयोधीते लोकेऽस्मिन् ख्याति यास्यति पाण्डवः॥
en: Sanjaya continued "Hearing this fallacious argument from Keshava, O king, Rama failed to remove his anger and become cheerful. He then said in that assembly, having unfairly killed the righteous king Suyodhana, the son of Pandu shall be known in the world as a wily warrior.

sa: आपत्स्वेव च वोढव्यं भवद्भिः पुणवैरिव। न च प्रियतरं कार्यं धनं कस्याञ्चिदापदि॥
en: In seasons of danger, you should, like strong bulls, bear such burdens. In seasons of distress, you should not value wealth too highly.

sa: उपातिष्ठत धर्मज्ञो भैक्षकाले स देवलम्। स दृष्ट्वा भिक्षुरूपेण प्राप्तं तत्र महामुनिम्॥
en: At the hour, however, of dinner, O Janamejaya, the intelligent and righteous ascetic, leading a life of mendicancy, approached Devala for soliciting aims.

sa: भीष्म उवाच पुरा दुर्योधनेनेह धृतराष्ट्राय मानद। आख्यातं तप्यमानेन श्रियं दृष्ट्वा तथागताम्॥ इन्द्रप्रस्थे महाराज तव सभ्रातृकस्य ह। सभायां चाह वचनं तत् सर्वं शृणु भारत॥
en: Bhishma said 'Formerly, O givers of honours, Duryodhana while burning within at your and your brothers' prosperity at Indraprastha, and for the jeers he received for his mistakes at the grand palace, had asked his father Dhritarashtra the same question. Hear what transpired at that time, O Bharata.

sa: अतिदुःखमिदं मूढ न जातु ब्राह्मणः सहेत्। क्षत्रियस्येव ते धैर्यं कामया सत्यमुच्यताम्॥
en: O fool, no Brahmana could bear such a pain! Your patience is like that of a Kshatriya! Tell me the truth, without fear.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच अव्याहरति कौन्तेये धर्मराजे युधिष्ठिरे। भ्रातॄणां ब्रुवतां तास्तान् विविधान् वेदनिश्चयान्॥
en: Vaishampayana said When after listening to his brothers who were telling these truths of the Vedas, Kunti's son king Yudhishthira just remained silent.

sa: एतद् विदित्वा तत्त्वेन शीलवान् भव पुत्रका यदीच्छसि श्रियं तात सुविशिष्टां युधिष्ठिरात्॥
en: Dhritarashtra said Knowing all this truly, do you, O son, be of good conduct, if you wish to obtain greater prosperity than Yudhishthira.'

sa: वज्रसारमयं नूनं हृदयं सुदृढं मम। यच्छुत्वा निहतान् पुत्रान् दीर्यते न सहस्रधा॥
en: Forsooth, my hard heart is made of the essence of thunder since it breaks not upon hearing of the fall of my sons!

sa: तस्मिन् सरसि कृत्वाहं विधिवत् तर्पणं पुरा। पितृणां देवतानां च ततोऽऽश्रममियां तदा॥
en: Having performed my ablutions in that lake duly offered libations of water to the departed manes and the gods, I entered the hermitage.

sa: यदतप्तं प्रणमते नैतत् संतापमर्हति। यत् स्वयं नमते दारु न तत् संनामयन्त्यपि॥
en: The wood that bends easily need not be heated. The tree that bends easily, is not required to suffer any torture. anger he

sa: प्रक्षीयमाणं तं दृष्ट्वा जलस्थायं भयागमे। अब्रवीद् दीर्घदर्शी तु तावुभौ सुहृदौ तदा॥
en: Seeing the water of the lake gradually decreasing, the fish that had much foresight, said to his two companions about the coming danger.

sa: ऋषयश्च हि देवाश्च प्रीयन्ते पितृभिः सह। पूज्यमानेषु गुरुषु तस्मात् पूज्यतमो गुरुः॥
en: If preceptors are adored the very Rishis, and the gods, together the Pitris, are all pleased. Therefore, the preceptor deserves the highest respect.

sa: न तु हन्यान्नृपो जातु दूतं कस्याञ्चिदापदि। दूतस्य हन्ता निरयमाविशेत् सचिवैः सह।॥
en: A king should never kill a messenger under any circumstances. That king who kills a messenger sinks into hell with all his ministers.

sa: मरुत्तेन हि राज्ञा वै गीत: श्लोकः पुरातनः। राजाधिकारे राजेन्द्र बृहस्पतिमते पुरा॥
en: There is an ancient Sloka recited by king Marutta, quite of a piece with Brihaspati's view, O king, about the duty of kings.

sa: पितामहेन यजता आहूता पुष्करेषु वै। सुप्रभा नाम राजेन्द्र नाम्ना तत्र सरस्वती॥
en: Summoned at Pushkara by the grandfather engaged in the celebration of a sacrifice, Sarasvati, O king came there under the name of Suprava.

sa: त्वां तु शोकेन संतप्तं मुह्यमानं मुहुर्मुहुः। ज्ञात्वा युधिष्ठिरो राजा प्राणानपि परित्यजेत्॥
en: If king Yudhishthira leans that you are overwhelmed with grief and losing your senses frequently, he will put an end to his life.

sa: कुम्भाश्च नगरद्वारि वारिपूर्णा नवा दृढाः। सिताः सुमनसो गौरा: स्थापितास्तत्र तत्र ह॥
en: New inetallic jars, brimful with water, were kept at the door of every house, and bevies of beautiful maidens stood at different parts.

sa: यस्मिन् राजर्षभे जाते धर्मात्मनि महात्मनि। अहृष्यन्नृषयः सर्वे स मां पृच्छतु पाण्डव॥
en: Let the son of Pandu, that virtuous and noble royal sage, upon whose birth all the Vrishnis were filled with joy, question me.

sa: रणमूर्ध्नि हतो भीष्मः पश्यतां वः किरीटिना॥ एवमेव हतो द्रोणः सर्वेषामेव पश्यताम्।
en: Bhishma was slain at the van of battle by the diadem-decked Arjuna in your presence. Even thus was Drona slain before you all.

sa: ततः सा सर्वमाचष्ट यथावृत्तं प्रवेपती। दुःखितामथ तां दृष्ट्वा ऊचुस्ते वै तपोधनाः॥
en: Thus accosted, Sarasvati, trembling as she spoke, informed them of everything that had taken place. Seeing her thus woe-begone, those ascetics told her-

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच कुरुक्षेत्रं ततो दृष्ट्वा दत्त्वा दायांश्च सात्वतः। आश्रमं सुमहद् दिव्यमगमजनमेजय॥
en: Vaishampayana said "Having visited Kurukshetra and distributed wealth there the Satwata hero then proceeded, O Janamejaya, to a large and exceedingly beautiful hermitage.

sa: अस्त्विदानीमियं राजन् केवला पृथिवी तव। असहायो हि को राजा राज्यमिच्छेत प्रशासितुम्।।४८
en: This empty Earth, O king, is now intended for you. What king would like to rule a kingdom divested of friends and allies?

sa: भीष्म उवाच राजमूला महाबाहो योगक्षेमसुवृष्टयः। प्रजासु व्याधयश्चैव मरणं च भयानि च॥
en: 'O mighty-armed one, the peace and prosperity of subjects, profuse and seasonable rain, disease, death, and other calamities, all depend on the king.

sa: सत्त्वं रजस्तम इति मानसाः स्युस्त्रयो गुणाः। तेषां गुणानां साम्यं यत्तदाहुः स्वस्थलक्षणम्॥
en: Goodness, darkness, and ignorance are the three qualities of the mind. The harmonious existence of these three is the sign of (mental) health.

sa: त्वमेव प्रीतिमांस्तस्मात् कुरूणां कुरुसत्तम। भव राजा जय स्वर्ग सतो रक्षासतो जहि॥
en: Be you gladly the king of the Kurus, O foremost one of Kuru's race, acquire heaven, protect the good, and kill the wicked.

sa: अद्य राजास्मि गोविन्द पृथिव्यां भ्रातृभिः सह। त्वया नाथेन वीरेण विदुषा परिपालितः॥
en: "Having got you, highly wise as you are, as may lord and protector, I, O Govinda, the king of earth with my brothers.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच तच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं घोरं संजयस्य महीपतिः। गतासुरिव निश्चेष्टो न्यपतत् पृथिवीतले॥
en: Vaishampayana said Hearing these dreadful words of Sanjaya, the king dropped down on the Earth and lay unconscious like one deprived of life.

sa: सात्यकिं च शतेनाजौ सहदेवं त्रिभिः शरैः। ततस्तु शसरं चापं नुकलस्य महात्मनः॥
en: Striking Yudhishthira with three arrows and Bhima with seven, Shalya pierced Satyaki with a hundred arrows in that battle and Sahadeva with three.

sa: ततः कृपश्च द्रौणिश्च कृतवर्मा च सात्वतः॥ संनिविष्टेषु पार्थेषु प्रयातास्तं ह्रदं शनैः।
en: After the Parthas had gone to their camp, Kripa and Drona's son and Kritavarman of the Satwata race slowly went towards that lake.

sa: अवश्यं भवितव्ये च कुरूणां वैशसे नृप। कस्माच्छोचसि ताशूरान् गतान् परमिकां गतिम्।।
en: This destruction of the Kurus, O king, was inevitable. Why then do you grieve for those heroes that have achieved the highest end?

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच श्रुता मे कथताः पूर्वे चत्वारो मानवाश्रमाः। व्याख्यानयित्वा व्याख्यानमेषामाचक्ष्व पृच्छतः॥शा
en: Yudhishthira said You have described to me the four modes of life. I desire to know more of them. Do you describe them.'

sa: कामक्रोधौ पुरस्कृत्य योऽर्थं रजानुतिष्ठति। न स धर्मं न चाप्यर्थं प्रतिगृह्णाति बालिशः॥
en: That foolish king, who pursues Profit without being shorn of lust and anger, fails to win virtue and ultimately losses Profit as well.

sa: हितं तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा कौसल्योऽप्यजयन्महीम्। तथा च कृतवान् राजा यथोक्तं तेन भारत॥
en: Having listened to his wholesome advice, the king of Koshala conquered the whole Earth and acted in every way as the sage directed.

sa: ततः सुस्थमिदं सर्वं बभूव पुनरेव हि। सर्वाणि च हवींष्यस्य देवा भागमकल्पयन्॥
en: The world was once more saved. The gods assigned to Mahadeva all the libations of clarified butter as his share of sacrificial offerings.

sa: मरणान्तमिदं सर्वं नेह किञ्चिदनामयम्। तस्माद् धर्मे स्थितो राजा प्रजा धर्मेण पालयेत्॥
en: Everything belonging to this world is liable to destruction. Nothing here is lasting. Therefore, the king, following righteousness, should protect his subjects righteously.

sa: एवं शस्त्राणि मुञ्चन्तो प्रन्ति वध्याननेकथा। तस्यैषां निष्कृतिः कृत्स्ना भूतानां भावनं पुनः॥
en: Those, who use weapons, destroy many who deserve to be killed. Such wholesale destruction, however, helps the growth and advancement of the remnant.

sa: भगस्य नयने चैव बाहू च सवितुस्तथा। प्रादात् पूष्णश्च दशनान् पुनर्यज्ञांश्च पाण्डव॥
en: He then gave to Savitri his arms, Bhaga his eyes, and Pushna his teeth. And he also restored the Sacrifices themselves, O Pandava.

sa: एवं प्रयोजनश्चैव दण्डः क्षत्रियतां गतः। रक्षन् प्रजाः स जागर्ति नित्यं स्ववहितोऽक्षरः॥
en: For serving this object, punishment assumes the form of a Kshatriya among men. Protecting men he remains awake, always careful and never decaying.

sa: कोशश्च सततं रक्ष्यो यत्नमास्थाय राजभिः। कोशमूला हि राजानः कोशो वृद्धिकरो भवेत्॥
en: Kings, should, always, diligently look after their treasuries. Indeed, kings depend on their treasuries A king should, always, try to swell his treasures.

sa: बहुरूपाः प्रजाः सृष्टा विवृद्धाश्च स्वतेजसा। चुक्रोध भगवान् रुद्रो लिङ्गं स्वं चाप्यविध्यत॥ तत् प्रविद्धं तथा भूमौ तथैव प्रत्यतिष्ठत। तमुवाचाव्ययो ब्रह्मा वचोभिः शमयन्निव॥ किं कृतं सलिले शर्व चिरकालस्थितेन ते। किमर्थं चेदमुत्पाद्य लिङ्गं भूमौ प्रवेशितम्॥
en: He saw that various kinds of creatures had been created and that they had multiplied themselves. Seeing it, Rudra became angry and made his generative organ disappear in the bowels of the Earth. Then soothing him by soft words, Brahman said to him-O Sarva, what were you doing so long within the water? Why have you made your generative organ disappear in the bowels of the Earth?

sa: निर्यज्ञास्तपसा हीना मा स्म तैः सह सङ्गमः॥ धननाशाद् दुःखतरं जीविताद् विप्रयोजनम्।
en: Abandon their companionship who do not perform sacrifices and penances. If their wealth be lost, they commit even suicide which is highly pitiable.

sa: एवमेव यथाऽऽत्थ त्वं मातुलेह न संशयः। तैस्तु पूर्वमयं सेतुः शतधा विदलीकृतः॥
en: Ashvatthaman said “Forsooth what you say, O maternal uncle, is true. The Pandavas, however, have, before this, deviated from the path of righteousness.

sa: नृपतेर्भग्नसक्थस्य श्रुत्वा तादृग् वचः पुनः। यश्चायं मित्रपक्षो मे मयि जीवति निर्जितः॥
en: Who is there somerciless whose eyes would not be filled with tears after hearing such words uttered by the king with broken thighs.

sa: सप्त मार्गा निरुद्धास्ते वायोरमिततेजसः॥ दिवं ते शिरसा व्याप्तं पद्भ्यां देवी वसुन्धरा।
en: You stand closing the seven paths of the powerful Wind. The sky is occupied by your head, and the Earth by your feet.

sa: पाणिभिश्चापरा जन्ति शिरांसि मधुसूदन। प्रेक्ष्य भ्रातॄन् पितॄन् पुत्रान् पतींश्च निहतान् परैः॥
en: Others, seeing their brothers, sires, sons, and husbands killed by enemies, are, O slayer of Madhu, striking their heads with their own hands.

sa: धूमो वायोरिव वशे बलं धर्मोऽनुवर्तते। अनीश्वरो बले धर्मो दुमे वल्लीव संश्रिता॥
en: As smoke depends upon the wind, so Righteousness depends upon Power. Righteousness which is the weaker of the two depends upon a tree.

sa: मृतं वा यदि वा नष्टं योऽतीतमनुशोचति। दुःखेन लभते दुःखं द्वावनौँ प्रपद्यते॥
en: Dead or lost, the person who grieves for what has already taken place, and suffers great grief. By grieving one increases it twofold.

sa: ततः स राजा सस्मार मामेव गतमानसः। तदाहं चिन्तनं ज्ञात्वा गतवांस्तस्य दर्शनम्॥
en: In that plight the king thought of me with rapt attention. Knowing that the king was thinking of me I appeared before him.

sa: यस्य योधाः सुसंतुष्टाः सान्त्विताः सूपधास्थिताः। अल्पेनापि स दण्डेन महीं जयति पार्थिवः॥
en: That king whose soldiers are contented, gratified and competent to impose on foes, can, with even a small force, subjugate the whole Earth.

sa: यस्यावाच्यं न लोकेऽस्ति नाकार्यं चापि किंचन। वाचं तेन न संदध्याच्छुचिः संश्लिश्कर्मणा॥
en: A person of pure conduct should never even speak with that sinful person, who does not scruple to utter anything or do anything.

sa: कृत्वा सर्वाणि कार्याणि सम्यक् सम्पाल्य मेदिनीम्। पालयित्वा तथा पौरान् परत्र सुखमेधते॥
en: 'Having satisfied all his duties and having protected the Earth, and having also protected the cities, a king enjoys great happiness in heaven.

sa: तस्मिन् ह्रदं प्रविष्टे तु त्रीन् रथान् श्रान्तवाहनान्। अपश्यं सहितानेकस्तं देशं समुपेयुधः॥
en: After he had entered that lake, myself, without anybody on my side, saw those three car-warriors coming together there with their tired animals.

sa: द्विजाते: कस्यचित् पार्थ स्वाध्यायनिरतस्य वै। बभूव पुत्रो मेधावी मेधावी नाम नामतः॥
en: A certain Brahmana, O Partha, who was given to the study of the Vedas, got a very intelligent son who was called Medhavin.

sa: तस्करेभ्यः परेभ्यो वा ये भयार्ता युधिष्ठिर। अर्थिनो भोक्तुमिच्छन्ति तेषु दत्तं महाफलम्॥
en: By making gifts to those persons, O Yudhishthira, who having lost everything through thieves or oppressors, approach the giver one gains great merit.

sa: तस्य पञ्चशिखः शिष्यो मानुष्या पयसा भृतः। ब्राह्मणी कपिला नाम काचिदासीत् कुटुम्बिनी॥
en: Panchashikha became a disciple of Asuri. He lived on human milk. There was a certain Brahman lady named Kapila. She was Asuri's wife.

sa: ततस्तामब्रवीत् तत्र लोकानां प्रभवाप्ययः। किमिदं वर्तते पुत्रि क्रियतां मम तद् वचः॥
en: Going there the Creator and Destroyer of the universe again addressed her saying,-What are you doing, O daughter! Satisfy those words of mine!

sa: सांख्यं योगः पाञ्चरात्रं वेदाः पाशुपतं तथा। ज्ञानान्येतानि राजर्षे विद्धि नामामतानि वै॥
en: There are various kinds of religion, O royal sage, who go by various names such as Sankhya, Yoga, the Panch-ratra, Vedas, and Pashupati.

sa: दावाग्निनेव निर्दग्धा सपुष्पस्तवका लता॥ भस्मीभवति सा नारी यस्या भर्ता न तुष्यति।
en: That wife with whom her husband is not pleased is reduced to ashes, like a creeper adorned with flowers in a forest fire.

sa: त्वं वै प्रभार्चिः पुरुषः सर्वस्य हृदि संश्रितः। अणिमा महिमा प्राप्तिरीशानो ज्योतिरव्ययः॥
en: You are the original lustre. You are Male Being living in the hearts of all things. You are the successful fruits of Yoga.

sa: ततः स भगवान् रुद्रो दानवक्षतजोक्षितम्॥ असिं धर्मस्य गोप्तारं ददौ सत्कृत्य विष्णवे।
en: After this the divine Rudra gave the sword, that protector of religion, covered with the blood of Danavas, to Vishnu with proper adorations.

sa: सर्वेष्वेव तु कार्येषु दैवपूर्वेषु भारत। हन्ति पुत्रान् पशून् कृत्स्नान् ब्राह्मणातिक्रमः कृतः।।८४
en: The man who transgresses against a Brahmana by obstructing the adoration of gods, suffer from the loss of all his children and animals.

sa: पृच्छमानाय तत्त्वेन मया चैवोत्तमा तव। कथेयं कथिता पुण्या धा धर्मभृतां वर॥
en: Asked by you, O foremost of pious men, I have recited this history that is excellent and sacred and endued with great merit.

sa: एतत् ते कथितं तात भार्गवस्य महात्मनः। चरितं भरतश्रेष्ठ यन्मां त्वं परिपृच्छसि॥
en: I have thus described to you, O chief of the Bharatas, the story of the great Bhargava about which you had asked me.

sa: किं तु यानि विदुर्लोके ब्राह्मणा: शार्ङ्गधन्वनि। माहात्म्यानि महाबाहो शृणु तानि युधिष्ठिर॥
en: Listen now, O Yudhisthira of powerful arms, those attributes which great Brahmanas say are to be seen in the great wielder of Sharnga.

sa: पुत्र शीघ्रमितो गत्वा राजधर्मनिवेशनम्॥ ज्ञायतां स विशुद्धात्मा यदि जीवति मा चिरम्।
en: O son, going hence with great speed to the house of Rajdharman, learn whether that puresouled bird is still alive! Do not delay.

sa: तस्य चिन्तयतः सृष्टिं महानात्मगुणः स्मृतः॥ अहंकारस्ततो जातो ब्रह्मा स तु चतुर्मुखः।
en: While engaged in thinking of Creation, he recollects his own great qualities. From this originates the four-faced Brahman representing the Consciousness of Aniruddha.

sa: मृता गर्भेषु जायन्ते जातमात्रा म्रियन्ति च। चङ्क्रमन्तो म्रियन्ते च यौवनस्थास्तथा परे॥
en: Some die in the womb; some die soon after birth; some die while crawling; some die in youth; and some in old age.

sa: अद्रोहः सर्वभूतेषु कर्मणा मनसा गिरा। अनुग्रहश्च दानं च सतां धर्मः सनातनः॥
en: Abstention froin injury to all creatures in thought, word, and deed, and kindness, and gift, are the permanent duties of the good. one

sa: प्रतिरूपं यथैवाप्सु तापः सूर्यस्य लक्ष्यते। सत्त्ववत्सु तथा सत्त्वं प्रतिरूपं स पश्यति॥
en: As the shining solar disc is seen reflected in the reflected water so the Yogin sees reflected within gross bodies the existent self.

sa: एवं बुद्ध्वा नरः सर्वं भूतानामागतिं गतिम्। समवेक्ष्य च वैषम्यं लभते शममुत्तमम्॥
en: By thus knowing the origin and end of all creatures, and by thus apprehending their distinctions, a person succeeds in acquiring high felicity.
